By and large, the revenue, the margins, the cash flow, all 3 parameters and balance sheet should definitely become far better than what it is today with a large chunk of repayment.

items.statement: Targets domestic retail business growth above 15% in FY27
items.quote: So our target is that the retail business should grow more than 15%, right? And that was in the current quarter also in the whole year, but we ended up at 13% because of lack of sales in March because of the shock.

items.statement: Invested INR140 crores in beverage bottling lines in Dec-Mar quarters; discussing 3 more lines for FY27
items.quote: So the bottling beverage business, we have invested approximately INR140 crores over the last couple of quarters, December and March quarter. And the first project is already online. It's working.

items.statement: Overall EBITDA margin improved to 13.2% in Q4 FY26 from 12.8% YoY; Hi-Tech margin at 19.8% vs 17.5%
items.quote: We have been able to improve the margin. Overall margin came at 13.2% as against 12.8% across all the divisions. Within individual businesses, Hi-Tech came out at 19.8% as against last year same period, 17.5%.

items.statement: Polymer prices spiked 50-60% in March then partially retreated; PVC down to ~10% above Feb levels, polyethylene still ~40% up
items.quote: And we saw that between 20th February to sometimes in 25th of March, prices had gone up substantially, resulting into almost -- at one point, there were more than 50% increase in the raw material prices within a space of about 20 days. And on polyethylene side, it was, in fact, 60% increase.

items.statement: Hi-Tech (drip, tissue culture) grew 20% in FY26 driving margin expansion; beverage lines started; tomato processing plant to start Jan FY27
items.quote: But within that 11%, you would see that the Hi-Tech business grew more than 20%. So that has been really heartening to see that the business which is most profitable, grew at the best rate.

items.statement: Cautious on FY27 due to unpredictable raw material prices, geopolitical/export uncertainty, and debt repayments due Sept 2026 and Mar 2027
items.quote: In overall scene, we are cautious right now, right, because of this unpredictable scenario related to major raw materials which we have in terms of the plastics, which we use in drip and pipe business.

items.statement: Targets PAT positive in FY27 after adjusting for one-time tax regime change and NCD unwinding impacts
items.quote: For FY '27, right, our plan right now is to be PAT positive. But I want to just bring attention to one part, right? That's a pain felt by us also, right, that whether you are unpaid employees of the banks after doing all the work.

items.statement: Tomato processing plant with Japanese partner expected to start in January FY27 (tomato season)
items.quote: The other business which we are working on a collaboration with the Japanese company, it's about tomato processing. That plant would start sometimes, I think, January. That is the next mango season -- sorry, tomato season when that comes through.

items.statement: Expects stronger demand for water management products in coming months due to below-normal monsoon forecast
items.quote: And we expect that over the next few months, as this is expected also to be -- monsoon is expected to be lower than normal. We expect stronger demand for water management products from farmers.

items.statement: Operating cash flow post working capital was ~INR600 crores in FY26 (76% of EBITDA); targets 4-figure cash flow in FY27 via receivables recovery
items.quote: And that's important to know because that is what our really focus is going forward next year also that almost -- if you look at for the whole FY '26, whatever EBITDA we generated, almost about 76% was operating cash flow post working capital change was created in that to -- in north of about INR600 crores

items.statement: Sterling expects to cross 95 resorts and 4,500 rooms in 2027 with 20+ sign-ups in pipeline
items.quote: We expect to cross 95 resorts and 4,500 rooms in 2027, with more than 20 sign-ups in our pipeline actively coming on board.

items.statement: Demerger of Sterling Holiday Resorts expected to complete by Q1 FY28
items.quote: We expect this process to get completed by Q1 of FY '28, which was the original timeline that we had intimated.

items.statement: Sterling maintains EBITDA margin 31%+ and PBT margin 21% with debt-free balance sheet
items.quote: Importantly, we have achieved this while maintaining healthy profitability metrics with an EBITDA margins of 31% and over and PBT margins of 21% combined with a debt-free balance sheet.

items.statement: Travel segment 5% EBIT margin target intact despite short-haul shift and geopolitical headwinds
items.quote: I would think the 5% that we have said is our objective to get to is not getting disturbed.

items.statement: Airfares surged 30-50% on most westbound routes due to geopolitical tensions
items.quote: We are seeing airfares surge by 30% to 50% on most westbound routes.

items.statement: Prepaid forex card expanded to 28 global currencies from 12 in Dec 2025; float at INR 16bn on USD 764mn load volumes
items.quote: A noteworthy development on our prepaid forex card is that it has expanded today to 28 global currencies, from 12 that we were operating in December of 2025.

items.statement: Middle East conflict caused 50% revenue decline in Desert Adventures; DEI Q4 EBIT negative INR 10cr vs +INR 7cr YoY
items.quote: The largest impact of the geopolitical instability is visible in the number for our Desert Adventures operations in the Middle East, which declined by 50% in the quarter.

items.statement: Board recommended dividend of INR 0.50 per INR 1 face value share for FY26
items.quote: Our Board of Directors have recommended a dividend of INR 0.50 to INR 1 face value share, subject to approval of the shareholders.

items.statement: FY27 CapEx outlined at INR 35 billion with nearly 80% towards growth and capacity expansion projects
items.quote: For FY'27, we have outlined a CapEx of INR 35 billion, with nearly 80% towards growth and capacity expansion projects.

items.statement: Of INR 3,500 crores FY27 CapEx, close to INR 3,000 crores in India for truck and car tyre expansion; balance in Europe for Hungary passenger car tyre expansion
items.quote: So close to INR 3,000 crores out of the INR 3,500 crores would be in India, where we are expanding capacity both in truck and car tyres. In Europe, in the Hungary plant, there is only a passenger car tyre expansion, which is also already well underway. So the balance would be in Europe.

items.statement: India margins under pressure from increased costs; mitigating through calibrated price increases and disciplined cost control
items.quote: As for India, the margins will remain under pressure on account of the increased cost as we attempt to offset them through price increases.

items.statement: Europe EBITDA margin improved to 14.6% in Q4 FY26 from 14.3% YoY; expect positive margin impact from Enschede closure in H2 FY27
items.quote: In H2 of FY '27, the positive impact of margins as we become more cost competitive for our European operations should start flowing in.

items.statement: Raw material costs expected to rise in high teens sequentially; announced price increases of 6% to 8% for current quarter; more price increases needed
items.quote: Raw material costs are expected to rise in high teens on a sequential basis. And we have already announced price increases of 6 % to 8% for this current quarter. More price increases would further be needed.

items.statement: Europe announced 2% price increase; further increases needed; Europe needs less than half price increase vs raw material basket compared to India's two-thirds
items.quote: We've announced a 2% price increase in Europe also, Vijay. Europe, we are more a follower given our size relative to some of the global majors. So, we follow their pricing actions based on their announcements. You need to keep in mind that for the same level of increase of raw material, the price increases needed in Eu

items.statement: Demand remains strong across categories and channels; April showing equally strong volume growth; expect momentum to continue through Q1
items.quote: In terms of outlook, demand remains strong across categories and channels, with April already showing equally strong volume growth, and we expect the same momentum to continue through Q1.

items.statement: Geopolitical developments in West Asia adding significant volatility to raw material, energy, and logistics costs impacting near-term margins
items.quote: Growth in certain international markets was impacted by the geopolitical developments in West Asia, which continue to create significant uncertainty and add volatility to raw materials, to energy and to logistics costs.

items.statement: Enschede plant closure on track; non-cash write-off of EUR 43 million taken on fixed assets this quarter; EUR 55 million cash provision for social plan and legal costs in FY27
items.quote: The closure of the Enschede plant production remains on track. And as mentioned earlier, we have assessed now the fixed assets at the plant as we enter into the last month, and a non-cash write-off of EUR 43 million has been taken on the fixed assets this quarter.

items.statement: Consolidated ROCE for FY26 stood at 13.4%, improvement of 240 bps vs FY25; net debt to EBITDA improved from 3.2x to 0.4x
items.quote: Helped by healthy margin performance, our consolidated ROCE for FY'26 stood at 13.4%, an improvement of around 240 basis points compared to FY'25.

items.statement: Transitioned to concessional tax regime effective FY27; applicable tax rate reduces from 34% to 25%; deferred tax liabilities provided positive net impact of almost INR 570+ crores recognised in P&L
items.quote: Additionally, following the enactment of the Finance Act 2026, we decided to transition to the concessional tax regime effective FY '27. With this transition, our applicable tax rate reduces from 34% to 25%, and consequently, our deferred tax liabilities have provided a positive net impact of almost INR 570 plus crores

items.statement: EBITDA margin improved 25% YoY in Q1 CY26 driven by sales mix and operational efficiency
items.quote: EBITDA improved by 25%, 24.8% like year-on-year, first quarter last year versus this year quarter 1.

items.statement: EBIT margin excluding prior-period depreciation charge improved to 27.8% in Q1 CY26
items.quote: If I exclude the exceptional item of depreciation, it has actually gone up to 27.8%, which is consistent with the growth that we have seen in the EBITDA.

items.statement: EBIT margin at 8% of sales in Q1 CY26 excluding prior-period depreciation charge
items.quote: Then we are at 8% EBIT for the quarter, which is in line with the EBIT that we have demonstrated in the quarter 4 last year and almost 1.7% or 170 basis points higher versus the quarter 1 of last year.

items.statement: Low to medium double-digit raw material cost impact seen; most costs passed through to customers with minimal margin impact
items.quote: I think overall, we have probably low to medium double-digit raw material impact on our products overall. The good news there is, firstly, there's no issue with availability.

items.statement: Price pass-through implemented swiftly; future orders locked in with new pricing by end of March
items.quote: In fact, by end of March, we had almost all our future orders locked in with the new pricing.

items.statement: Demand growing at usual industry rates of 5-7% annually; large MNC customers growing 2-5%, regional customers faster
items.quote: usually 6%, 5% to 7% is the increase every year. Some customers increase more. Some customers do less. For example, the large customers that we play in, usually, they are less, maybe 2% to 3% to 5%.

items.statement: Focus on higher-value business aligned with innovation, premiumization and sustainability; selective participation in value-aligned segments
items.quote: We are going after higher-value business, which is also consistent with our strategy and our strength in terms of the innovation leader in the industry.

items.statement: Solar captive electricity project at Khopoli plant signed and being executed; expected to go live in next few months with benefits in H2
items.quote: I'm also happy to report that we actually engaged in a formal agreement for developing a solar captive electricity project in our Khopoli plant. So that's been signed. It's being executed now, and we expect to go live in the next few months.

items.statement: Capital spent on solvent cooling equipment across plants to reduce solvent consumption
items.quote: We've installed a lot of equipment. We spent some capital in solvent cooling, for example.

items.statement: No inorganic opportunities currently on radar; focus on organic growth aligned with value proposition
items.quote: So I think the short answer is not at the moment. But if something comes up, we would definitely look at that. But right now, it's not in our radar at the moment.

items.statement: Daman property put up for sale after curtailing operations there
items.quote: So we have a property in Daman, which we have actually put up on sale. So we have curtailed our operations there and it's related to that.

items.statement: ECB loan from parent partially repaid; remaining portion to be paid by June 2027 per RBI guidelines
items.quote: A part of it still remains, which has to be paid over a period of time as prescribed, by June '27.

items.statement: Next reporting end of July for Q2 CY26 results
items.quote: I think in terms of reporting, I think you've seen our calendar, our next reporting is going to be end of July, and we'll talk to you a bit more on our results in second quarter.

items.statement: Interest on income tax refund of INR 6.5 crores received in Q1 CY26
items.quote: So it's about INR 6.5 crores that we have received.

items.statement: Retention via dynamic pricing: lower rates, higher limits, faster UX for repeat borrowers
items.quote: once they basically come onto our platform, show that, you know, they're a good customer making repayments on time, we basically, you know, try and essentially, next time when they come to our platform, you know, reduce the pricing for them

items.statement: Received marketing and manufacturing licenses for H9N2 Avian Influenza vaccine, strengthening biological portfolio in poultry segment
items.quote: During the quarter, we also received both the marketing and manufacturing licenses for H9N2 Avian Influenza vaccine. This is an important milestone for Hester and further strengthens our biological portfolio in the poultry segment.

items.statement: Capitalized Fill-Finish and BSL-3 facilities; undertaking optimization initiatives for BSL-3 to improve utilization efficiency and operating cost
items.quote: During the year, we capitalized our Fill-Finish as well as BSL-3 facilities, as a part of our broader manufacturing and infrastructure expansion initiative.

items.statement: Will calibrate price actions wherever required to manage periodic cost pressures from raw material inflation
items.quote: While these may create periodic cost pressures, we continue to focus on operational efficiency and calibrate price actions wherever required.

items.statement: Aims to return to 50-50 revenue mix between Poultry and Animal Healthcare from current 70-30 skew; R&D pipeline focused on Animal Health biologicals
items.quote: There has been a time, I think, 2 years ago where both were almost 50%, 50%, and that is what we are aiming at where we are not hyper-dependent on any one division.

items.statement: Net debt reduced to INR 70 crores from INR 102 crores; debt-to-equity at 0.19x, considered comfortable; no immediate need for fresh debt
items.quote: Currently, sir, the debt is around INR70 crores, right? It's reduced from INR102 crores, okay? So I think this is - the debt to equity is currently 0.19 times from what it has reduced. So I think this is quite comfortable for us at this level.

items.statement: Africa sales invoiced in USD for cross-border transactions and local currency for domestic sales; participating in Tanzania livestock vaccination drive discussions
items.quote: Invoicing to the other countries in U.S. dollars and for the local, it is a local currency.

items.statement: Petcare segment scaling gradually across selected therapeutic and supplement products; no commercialized pet vaccines yet
items.quote: The Petcare segment continues to scale gradually across selected therapeutic and supplement products and remains a long-term strategic focus area for us.

items.statement: Regulatory requirements evolving globally may necessitate future capex; cannot foresee exact investment needed for compliance
items.quote: Regulatory processes are time and again evolved from the drug department and one has to comply. And it is an evolving process all over the world. So it is difficult to hypothesize and tell what could come from the drug department.

items.statement: Poultry segment achieved INR 65 crore quarterly revenue with 30%+ margins in Q4; management aims to sustain this trend but acknowledges external forces
items.quote: Sir, so now only concern is that whether this is a one-off considering high broiler prices in the fourth quarter? Or sir, you see this trend continuing of INR 65 crores quarterly revenue in the poultry segment with like 30s margins?

items.statement: Write-offs of INR 6.5 crore for bad debts in FY26 vs INR 2.4 crore last year; CFO expects reduction going forward
items.quote: See, this is Ashish. Now one is mainly there is again the provision of debtors as required, and there are a few old debts, which were non-recovered, which are identified and written off. So it comprises of that.

items.statement: FY27 revenue target of INR 250 crores and EBITDA margin target of 15%
items.quote: This quarter itself we have done INR 59 crores. So, multiplying by 4, you will see INR 240 crores is easily feasible. So, given some growth here and there, hitting INR 250 crores I think is certainly possible.

items.statement: EBITDA margin projected to improve from 11% to at least 15% in FY27
items.quote: I think EBITDA margin should move from 11% to at least 15% is our projection.

items.statement: Nashik office construction expected to complete by end of FY27, saving INR 2-2.5 crores annually from FY28
items.quote: Hopefully, in June, we will be raking the ground. And by the end of the financial year, the building should be up and ready. So, probably the cost savings of around INR 2 crores - INR 2.5 crores per annum can accrue in the next financial year, 2027-2028.

items.statement: CES order book grew ~70% YoY to ~$5 million; MES order book declined to $0.25 million
items.quote: CES orders have shot up from actually, it was $2.5 million when we started the year. In June 24 last year, the work on hand was $2.84 million. Today, the work on hand is close to $5 million. So, there is a jump of almost 60%-70%.

items.statement: Standalone EBITDA margin target 15-16% for FY27 after MES restructuring and productivity gains
items.quote: Our engineering services from India, now that we have curtailed the excess staff in MES, both the MES and civil from India, that's our core business, standalone business, will certainly go up by at least 15%-20% and EBITDA in the region of 15%-16%.

items.statement: Structural design target increased from 10% to 30-40% of civil revenues in 3-4 years via organic and inorganic growth
items.quote: I wish to see in 3-4 years at least 30%-40% of our revenues coming from design.

items.statement: AI seen as limited threat; may reduce headcount 5-10% but not disrupt engineering services business model
items.quote: AI has no role as far as designing and detailing is concerned because it is not easy to just make an AI-based construction. Nobody would take a risk at least for the next 5-10 years in my opinion.

items.statement: Beryl acquisition completed Nov 2025, contributed INR 23 crores revenue in 5 months; 40-person team retained fully
items.quote: Beryl standalone, they have done a turnover of INR 11 crores in Q3. So, total is INR 22 crores. Yes, INR 22.9 crores. So, almost INR 23 crores.

items.statement: FY26 consolidated EBITDA margin delivered 15-15.5% range; focus on yearly margin rather than quarterly volatility
items.quote: So far as depreciation is a major part of having a big setup of air as well as on the ground that we have. Yes, the quarter-on-quarter comes with variations with peak season kicking in typically in second half of the year. So we...our focus is normally to ensure a year-on-year yearly margin.

items.statement: General Price Increase (GPI) from Jan 1 2026 yielded realization improvement better than 4% blended, offsetting inflation
items.quote: Yes. So we did GPI from 1st of January, and it has been a little better than what we had last year as such. So it has provided a positive impact, helping us to mitigate the impact of the year-on-year inflation levels as such.

items.statement: Ground Express (surface) remains primary growth engine; air e-commerce steady; overall volume growth ~7% FY26
items.quote: E-commerce, especially e-commerce on ground continues to be our growth driver, including the surface on ground as such. While the e-commerce on air has been steady, not very much too much growth over there.

items.statement: No specific volume or margin guidance for FY27; focus on balancing capacity with demand to protect absolute profitability and service quality
items.quote: Without really giving color of forward-looking statement, but this is a business which is largely a network business distributed all across India. So any significant upsurge or even shortfall in margin can impact either service quality or the profitability either way.

items.statement: No significant new charter opportunities from West Asia crisis; domestic charters continue on ad-hoc basis
items.quote: So, we may not see that...as of now, at least we don't have that big indication of new opportunities coming for charters because the passenger airlines also are...I mean, it's moving internationally.

items.statement: FY27 capex guided at INR375-400 crore, split across new projects, renovations, maintenance and IT
items.quote: So next year, I mean, financial year '27, we expect around INR375 crores to INR400 crores of overall capex, which will be spent across new projects as well as renovation of some of our high-value cinemas.

items.statement: FY27 new project capex INR225-250 crore, renovation INR80-100 crore, balance for maintenance and IT
items.quote: Roughly around about INR225 crores to INR250 crores we will spend on new projects, which will be across payments which are due for projects which are under fit-out as well as new handovers that will take within the year. And about INR80 crores to INR100 crores will be spent on renovation and the balance we will spend o

items.statement: FY26 EBITDA margin expanded to 14.4% from 8.4% YoY; Q4 EBITDA rose nearly 6x to INR169 crore
items.quote: On an IND AS 116 adjusted basis, FY26 revenues was a record of INR6,742 crores, up 16% year-on-year. EBITDA before exceptional items doubled to INR968 crores with margins expanding from 8.4% to 14.4%.

items.statement: FY26 ATP INR280 (+8% YoY), SPH INR147 (+10% YoY); Q4 ATP INR315, SPH INR165 — both record highs
items.quote: ATP for the year stood at INR280, which is up by 8% compared to previous year and SPH at INR147 compared -- up by 10% , both record highs. In Q4, ATP touched INR315 and SPH INR165.

items.statement: Targeting INR14,000 crores revenue in FY27 while maintaining current EBITDA margins
items.quote: Backed up by a strong order book of INR21,300 crores and robust opportunities across all verticals, we are targeting to achieve a revenue of INR14,000 crores in FY '27, while maintaining current margins.

items.statement: Defense revenue expected to cross INR4,500 crores in FY27
items.quote: The robust sales pipeline, coupled with strong execution capabilities position us well to sustain this momentum, and we should cross defense revenue of INR4,500 crores in FY '27.

items.statement: Planned annual capex of INR2,050 crores for FY27
items.quote: To support these growth plans, the company has invested INR2,700 crores over the last 2 years, and entering into FY '27 with a planned annual capex of INR2,050 crores.

items.statement: Order book stands at INR21,300 crores with defense at INR18,000 crores and non-defense at INR3,000 crores
items.quote: Out of the total INR21,000 crores of order book, defense is around INR18,000 crores, and nondefense is around INR3,000 crores.

items.statement: Achieved 28.5% EBITDA margin in Q4 FY26 and 27.95% for full year FY26
items.quote: We achieved our EBITDA margins at around 28.5% for this quarter and 27.95% for the whole year.

items.statement: Confident of maintaining current EBITDA margins in FY27 despite high raw material prices
items.quote: Despite of a very high base of raw material prices, which we are expecting in the coming financial year, we are pretty confident that we should be able to achieve the current levels of EBITDA margins.

items.statement: Expect 10-15% volume growth and 18-20% price rise contribution to domestic and international combined 30%+ growth in FY27
items.quote: Out of this 30%, 32% or 33% growth, we expect that 10% to 15% should come from volume growth and around 20% -- 18% to 20% should come from the price rise.

items.statement: Defense revenue surged 134% in Q4 and 94% for full year to INR1,008 crores and INR2,634 crores respectively
items.quote: Delivering outstanding growth with revenue surging 134% in Q4 and 94% for the full year to reach a record high of INR1,008 crores and INR2,634 crores, respectively.

items.statement: International business grew 32% year-on-year in FY26
items.quote: Solar's international business has performed very well, and as a result, we registered a growth of 32% year-on-year.

items.statement: Possible demand contraction for couple of months due to high commodity prices but no annual impact expected
items.quote: We do feel that there can be a demand contraction for some couple of months. But by and large, on an annual basis, I don't see that.

items.statement: 155mm complete round ammunition production facility to finish in next couple of quarters, then 3-4 months for qualification
items.quote: Our coupling facility, which will help us to produce the complete 155 mm product, we should be able to finish in next couple of quarters. But definitely, it will take another 3 to 4 months' time, then we will start supplying the complete round of 155 mm.

items.statement: FY27 sales booking guidance of INR 20,000 crores and new margin creation of INR 9,000-10,000 crores annually
items.quote: From a guidance standpoint, we had mentioned I think last year as well, that we believe that we will broadly stay on this trajectory of a INR 20,000 crores of sales guidance and ballpark about INR 9,000-odd crores of new margin creation every year.

items.statement: Dahlias sales expected to remain INR 5,000-6,000 crores in FY27
items.quote: So look, I think this year, the Dahlias sales was about INR5,000 crores and hopefully it stays to INR 5,000 crores to INR 6,000 crores next year as well.

items.statement: Rental business NOI growth guidance of mid-teens annually and 20-25% CAGR over next 4-5 years
items.quote: However, our 4 to 5-year guidance remains intact, that we will have mid-teens growth in NOI and 20 to 25% growth as a CAGR basis for the next 4 to 5 years.

items.statement: FY26 sales bookings of INR 20,143 crores, in line with guidance
items.quote: New sales bookings for the year was in line with our guidance and stood at INR 20,143 crores, led by successful sellout of Privana North in Gurugram, West Park in Mumbai and very well supported by our super luxury offering in Dahlias.

items.statement: FY27 launch pipeline ~INR 20,000 crores including Gurugram senior living, Hamilton 2, Westpark next phase, Dahlias continuation, and Goa launch
items.quote: We've got a healthy launch pipeline, almost about INR 20,000 crores. And we've got some good Gurugram products, we've got Mumbai, we've got Goa. And we've got some residual, and of course Dahlias.

items.statement: FY26 consolidated gross margin 39%; Q4 gross margin ~46%; targeting INR 9,000-10,000 crores annual margin creation
items.quote: Overall revenue stood approximately INR 10,000 crores with a gross margin of 39% for the fiscal.

items.statement: Sustained demand momentum across development business; super luxury Dahlias selling 32 units in Q4 at INR 135 crores avg; pricing exceeds South Mumbai
items.quote: In a particular quarter, we were able to sell 32 Apartments of Dahlias, which by itself is a remarkable feat.

items.statement: AI and geopolitical issues (Iran-US war) causing large tenant decision deferrals but no structural impact on rental business
items.quote: The recent issues related to AI and then the war between Iran and U.S. has not had any impact on the portfolio per se. However, there are large tenants who are reviewing their internal processes and internal decision-making and there could be some deferral in their decision-making.

items.statement: Dividend increased 33% YoY to INR 8/share; two-thirds driven by Cyber City (DCCDL) dividend; trajectory of growing dividends expected to continue
items.quote: In line with our stated commitment of enhancing shareholder return, combined with strong performance and growing cash flows, the Board has recommended a dividend of INR 8 per share for shareholders' approval, which represents a growth of 33% year-over-year.

items.statement: Net cash position INR 14,155 crores (INR 11,200 crores in RERA escrow); zero gross debt in development business achieved
items.quote: Our net cash position at the end of FY26 stood at INR 14,155 crores, of which close to INR 11,200 crores are in the RERA escrow accounts, signifying a robust balance sheet strength.

items.statement: DCCDL FY26 revenue INR 7,400 crores (+15%), EBITDA INR 5,700 crores (+16%), net profit INR 2,726 crores (+38%)
items.quote: For DCCDL, I think we had another outstanding year with revenues close to INR 7,400 crores, a growth of almost 15%. EBITDA at over INR 5,700 crores a growth of 16% and net profit before exception of INR 2,726 crores, a growth of almost 38%.

items.statement: Dahlias pricing: North units INR 90-110 crores, South units INR 20-30 crores discount; Camellias resale INR 80-150 crores; Gurgaon super-lux carpet rates now INR 150,000-160,000/sq ft matching/exceeding South Mumbai
items.quote: Dahlias is now touching about INR 135 crores per sale, that's where we are.

items.statement: Care Health Insurance expects sustainable GWP growth of 18-24% over next 3-4 years, aiming to outpace industry
items.quote: Range can be anything between 18% to 24%.

items.statement: Care Health Insurance targets combined ratio near 100% within 2 years driven by operating leverage on renewals
items.quote: Currently, our combined is at 101.4%. It should come down near 100% in 2 years' time line.

items.statement: REL allocated INR1,500 crore preferential issue proceeds: INR600 cr to Care, INR250 cr to Housing Finance, INR200 cr to Broking, INR375 cr general corporate
items.quote: Out of the INR1,500 crores, INR600 crores is going to Care, INR250 crores is going to the housing finance company, INR200 crores is going to the broking entity. And there's about INR375-odd crores, which is a general corporate purpose fund

items.statement: Care Health Insurance combined ratio improved 120 bps to 101.4% under Ind AS, driven by 100 bps loss ratio reduction and 20 bps expense ratio improvement
items.quote: Combined ratio under Ind AS improved by 120 basis points to 101.4%.

items.statement: Care Health Insurance retail health grew 37% YoY in Q4, outpacing industry by 8% in H2 FY26; GST exemption on individual health policies boosted affordability
items.quote: Our retail business grew 37% year-on-year on a full premium basis, with continued market share gain in the retail health insurance.

items.statement: Care Health Insurance retail mix improved 5% to 66% on 1/n basis; agency channel contributes 42% of GWP
items.quote: Additionally, the retail mix has improved by 5% this year, which takes it to 66% on 'n' basis.

items.statement: Demerger scheme approved to separate lending/broking into RFL and make REL pure-play health insurance holding company; RFL shareholders to get 1 RFL share per REL share
items.quote: Under the proposed demerger, REL's lending, broking and ancillary financial services business will move to RFL, while REL will become a pure play health insurance holding company through its stake in Care Health Insurance business.

items.statement: Promoters (Burman Group) subscribed to 50% of preferential rights issue (INR750 cr) and increased stake via open market purchases to ~30.3%; post warrant conversion expected ~34%
items.quote: The promoters have subscribed to 50% of the preferential rights issue with commitment of INR750 crores during the year.

items.statement: Housing Finance expects to turn profitable in 12-18 months as it scales up branch network and technology; currently doing ~INR10 cr/month disbursements
items.quote: I think maybe give it another 12 to 18 months. I think that would be a fair ask because you have to scale up and scale up will require some opex and capex.

items.statement: RFL NBFC to launch multi-product secured/unsecured lending over next few quarters after technology platform build-out; aims for pan-India distribution
items.quote: So I think that's what we are going to see over the next couple of quarters from the NBFC.

items.statement: RFL is debt-free with CRAR 261%, NNPA 0.8%, collection efficiency ~98%; PAT INR139 cr for FY26 (Q4 INR89 cr) driven by recoveries
items.quote: The NNPA stands at approximately 0.8% and CRAR is at 261%, well above regulatory requirements.

items.statement: Targets 10-12% volume growth and 1-2% price growth, aiming for ~15% revenue growth in FY27; price growth may be higher due to cost inflation
items.quote: As a company, we strive to grow between 10% to 12% in volume and there is a 1% to 2% price growth culminating into 15% growth, which is what we aim to do.

items.statement: Aims for at least 10% EBITDA margin in FY27 if summer is good, but cost inflation from West Asia conflict creates uncertainty
items.quote: I would say at least 10% is what we would like to expect there. But like I said, inflation is still something that is going to be a challenge.

items.statement: Electronics Q4 growth driven mostly by volume (~97%) with only 2-3% price contribution; pricing actions started late in quarter
items.quote: Roughly speaking, about 3% is price growth and the balance is volume.

items.statement: Channel financing covers ~35% of debtor portfolio, customer-linked not category-linked; collections strong in Q4, no working capital stress at dealers
items.quote: So, channel finance is for our primary customer. So approximately 35% of our business goes through channel financing arrangement. It's not category linked, it is customer linked.

items.statement: Kerala remittance risk from West Asia conflict not materialized yet; Kerala ~15-16% of revenue, summer supportive, real estate traction continues
items.quote: So far we have not seen any special impact in Kerala. In fact the summer in Kerala has been pretty supportive so the Kerala numbers are pretty good.

items.statement: Lighting foray work in progress, targeting market launch early next quarter (Q2 FY27)
items.quote: It's still work in progress for us. I think sometime towards early next quarter, we look forward to bringing it into market.

items.statement: H2 FY26 EBITDA ~9.5%, close to double-digit; confident of hitting 10%+ once raw material prices normalize post-conflict
items.quote: We have come back strongly and our H2 EBITDA is in the region of around 9.5%. So we are already close to double-digit numbers.

items.statement: Capex breakup: Rs 4,000-5,000 crore for thermal (Salboni) and pumped hydro; remainder for wind, solar, battery
items.quote: you can say ₹4,000-₹5,000 crores will be for these projects, which are the thermal project and the pump storage and rest all will be in the wind and solar space, and battery energy

items.statement: Merchant realizations maintaining 20%+ premium to exchange prices; April-May 2026 continuing same premium
items.quote: whatever merchant tariffs are being discovered in the market, we will definitely maintain at least minimum 20% premium and we are continuing with that

items.statement: Curtailment loss Rs 16 crore in Q4 FY26, Rs 50 crore full year; expected to end by July 2026 with new evacuation line
items.quote: Only a small portion of this curtailment has resulted in a revenue loss of around ₹16 crores during the quarter and approximately for ₹50 crores during the year gone by. This curtailment, however, is expected to be over by July'26

items.statement: Vision 2030: double GDV portfolio to over INR 35,000 crores; aim to achieve earlier
items.quote: As a part of our Vision 2030 road map, we now aspire to double our development portfolio to over INR35,000 crores of GDV through sustained business development and strategic expansion across Mumbai's most distinguished addresses.

items.statement: Net debt-free; consolidated net worth INR 2,266 crores, liquidity INR 686 crores, debt INR 58 crores
items.quote: And as of 2026, consolidated net worth stood as of March 2026, at approximately INR2,266 crores, while consolidated liquidity stood at approximately INR 686 crores. Consolidated debt remained extremely low at approximately INR58 crores, thereby maintaining MICL's net debt-free position.

name: Multi Commodity Exchange of India Ltd

items.statement: Management expects FY27 to be a strong year but acknowledges quarterly cyclicity and macro factors
items.quote: So, we believe the coming year will be a strong year. Exactly how each quarter will play out, of course, we'll wait and see how the numbers are. But we believe the year will be a strong year.

items.statement: Bullion volumes grew over 4x YoY; energy volumes grew strongly on a high base; both are key structural drivers
items.quote: While of course, bullion has had a much higher growth, and we are very happy about that. It has grown more than 4 times, the energy growth has also been good and strong over a very high base.

items.statement: Colocation services ready to launch at short notice if regulator permits
items.quote: If this were to get permitted by the regulator, we'll be able to take this to market fairly soon within the kind of market requirements required. So, we don't think we will have -- we will not be on the back foot there.

items.statement: Electricity derivatives in early stage with ~50 commercial participants and growing UCC; coal exchange to be set up as independent subsidiary, not part of MCX
items.quote: We've got about 50 participants from the commercial participant side and a large number of members who contribute and trade, the UCC numbers also are going up month-on-month. When it comes to coal, the coal Exchange is an independent entity. It will not be part of MCX as a company. It will operate as a subsidiary.

items.statement: Q4 FY26 interest income on margin money was INR59 crores vs INR22 crores in Q4 FY25
items.quote: This quarter, we have seen some increase in the margin money in terms of cash with the subsidiary, and that has helped in some increase in the income from that - INR59 crores in this quarter as against INR22 crores of previous year.

items.statement: Q4 FY26 transaction revenue: futures INR242 crores, options INR569 crores
items.quote: Futures revenue for Q4 is INR242 crores and options revenue is INR569 crores.

items.statement: FY26 consolidated revenue from operations more than doubled to INR2,302 crores; PAT crossed INR1,300 crores; EBITDA INR1,774 crores
items.quote: For the full year FY '26, the consolidated revenue from operations more than doubled to INR2,302 crores, and this was supported by nearly 2.5 times increase in the average daily turnover across both futures and options. The profit after tax crossed INR1,300 crores and EBITDA at INR1,774 crores.

items.statement: Management expects 40-50% revenue growth in FY27 backed by existing order book
items.quote: As our Honorable CMD sir has been telling about 40 % to 50% growth is what we are expecting in the coming year and we already have sufficient orders in hand for the same.

items.statement: Order book stands at ~2 GW and INR 3,000+ crores with 230 MW added in Q4
items.quote: Our current order book stands at nearly 2 gigawatt across multi-year projects with a total value of approximately INR 3,000 crores, providing strong revenue visibility in the coming years.

items.statement: Added INR 730+ crores of orders in Q4 FY26 excluding GST
items.quote: About INR 700 plus crores, INR 730 plus crores of orders have been added excluding GST value during the last quarter.

items.statement: FY26 EBITDA margin improved to 21.82% from 20.46% in FY25
items.quote: If you see compare it with the financial year last year '25, the EBITDA stood at 20.46% and when you see it current it is 21.82%. So, on the contrary in terms of percentages we have already improved on the EBITDA margin.

items.statement: IPP pipeline of 200 MW requires ~INR 1,700+ crores capex with INR 450+ crores equity
items.quote: Coming to an estimated project cost, roughly we can say that about INR 1,700 plus crores of total both the projects put together will be the project cost of which about INR 450 plus crores would be through equity and balance would be through debt.

items.statement: O&M revenue surged 350% YoY to INR 5.13 crores in Q4 FY26 managing 646 MW
items.quote: In Q4 FY26, our O&M quarterly revenue surged 350% year -on-year to INR 5.13 crores. We currently manage over 646 megawatt under our O&M portfolio.

items.statement: IPP project debt funding expected at 7.5-8.5% interest rate
items.quote: We expected to range between 7.5% to 8.5% depending upon our cycle.

items.statement: Received CERC interstate electricity trading license enabling pan-India power trading
items.quote: We have also received a CERC, Central Electricity Regulatory Commission, interstate electricity trading license, which enables us to participate in power markets across the country on a pan-India basis.

items.statement: Majority of current order book to be completed by FY27
items.quote: Majority of our projects will get completed by FY27.

items.statement: Order book split 50% group entity and 50% external; pipeline fully external
items.quote: On the INR 3,000 crores order book, approximately 50% is from the Group entity and the balance 50 is outside.

items.statement: India installed record 6.05 GW wind in FY26, highest ever annual addition
items.quote: The MNRE mentions that India installed 6.05 gigawatt of new wind capacity during the financial year 25-26 alone, the highest annual addition in the country's history.

items.statement: First in India to install 4.2 MW make-in-India wind turbine in South Gujarat
items.quote: We also take pride in being the first company in India to install the make in India 4.2 megawatt 160 wind turbine in South Gujarat, reflecting our continued focus on advanced technology adoption and execution excellence.

items.statement: Standalone core business capex estimated at Rs.300-350 Crores for FY27
items.quote: capex in our core business will be around Rs.300 Crores to Rs.350 Crores range.

items.statement: Subsidiaries (EV and Medical) capex estimated at ~Rs.300 Crores for FY27
items.quote: All put together, we have a rough cut estimate of around Rs.300 Crores going into the subsidiaries also.

items.statement: Commodity price increases passed through to customers with 1-2 quarter lag; fuel inflation being negotiated
items.quote: commodity price increase, we get it from our customers because we have contracts in place, which comes with sometimes a one or two quarter lag that will be recovery. The immediate challenge is how to get the inflation on the fuel and this thing, which we have taken up with our customers.

items.statement: EV localization progressing: Montra Electric Rhino first truck certified under PM E-drive scheme in Q4 FY26
items.quote: Our Montra Electric Rhino was the first electric truck in the country to be certified under the PM E-drive scheme, which happened in Q4, and we could deliver vehicles under this particular scheme.

items.statement: CDMO plant at Naidupet under final commissioning; commercial production starting Q1 FY27
items.quote: our plant is under final commissioning. And we are going to do the commercial production from our Naidupet facility starting next quarter.

items.statement: Sodium-ion battery technology not an immediate TCO benefit; validation and implementation is long-drawn process
items.quote: Not immediately because the technology getting translated into a cell and then coming on to the validation and the full-fledged implementation on the vehicle is a slightly long drawn process, so maybe in times to come, yes, but immediately no.

items.statement: Long-term growth guidance of 18-20% value growth maintained for medium term
items.quote: We have always been giving a long-term guidance of 18% to 20% growth, which we have also delivered in the past and we still believe that for a medium to long term, the company will deliver the same kind of growth in future also.

items.statement: Greenfield plant production to start September 2026 after delays from approvals and Iran war logistics
items.quote: The new plant is going to start its production in September '26. September '26 it will start the production. So, when the heavy half, which is seasonally heavy half, is the second half.

items.statement: Order book stands at INR 808 crores as of March 31, 2026, providing strong revenue visibility
items.quote: As of 31st March 2026, our order book stands at INR808 crores, providing strong revenue visibility.

items.statement: Operating margin improved to 10.8% in FY26, guided range 10.5-11% maintained
items.quote: Operating margin improved to 10.8%, reflecting enhanced operational efficiency.

items.statement: 12% realization growth and 8% volume growth for core products in Q4 FY26; 8% realization growth for full year FY26
items.quote: For the quarter, 12% is the realization growth and 8% volume growth for the core products.

items.statement: Order booking deferred in March due to sudden aluminium and PVC price spike; acceptance now improving
items.quote: There is an acceptance of the higher raw material prices. And I also feel that there is some I mean given the criticality of the power infrastructure, it cannot be deferred beyond a point.

items.statement: Solar cables share increased to 18% of FY26 revenue from 10% in FY25; expected to reach 20-23% in FY27
items.quote: From 18% it can go up to anywhere between 20% to 23% kind of should be the incremental share which should come.

items.statement: FY26 capex elevated due to greenfield plant; FY27 capex to continue but less intense; asset turns historically 6-7x
items.quote: Going forward in FY27 or probably in the medium term, you can say there would be capital expenditure each and every year because growth will demand capex. It may not be as intense as it was in FY26.

items.statement: Discontinued low-voltage conductors and railway signaling cables; railway cables contribution zero in FY26 vs 4% in FY25
items.quote: Railway cables we have discontinued for now because as we have been always discussing this over the last three, four, five quarters, that railway signaling we feel that competitive intensity is very high.

items.statement: TS Conductor partnership for HTLS conductors; no significant incremental capex needed; type testing and approvals to take ~1 year
items.quote: It is basically stepping stone or basically a starting step to venture into this high voltage conductor market for our company.

items.statement: Export share target 10-15% medium to long term; US distributor links being re-established after tariff disruption
items.quote: We believe that our export share on a long-term basis should hit 10% and should increase to 15% kind of level in the medium to long term.

items.statement: Net debt increase QoQ due to seasonal working capital borrowings in March; on-book debt reduced from INR 66 cr to INR 40 cr
items.quote: Sir, the entire borrowing which you look at is our working capital borrowings. So it all depends on the seasonality. March is a heavy quarter for all the cable manufacturers.

items.statement: B2B wire business entry leveraging existing cable relationships; margins expected similar to current business
items.quote: We will confine ourselves to the B2B wire market and leverage our existing DNA because in cables, we are already a B2B supplier to many of the B2B players.

items.statement: CPP order book stands at INR5,246 crores
items.quote: So current CPP order book, if you see, we have approximately INR5,246 crores of order book on the CPP side.

items.statement: IPP segment EBITDA margin 85-90%; overall margins targeted stable via IPP-EPC mix
items.quote: As you know, the IPP segment gives you a very strong EBITDA. It's about 85% to 90% of EBITDA.

items.statement: India renewable demand supports 40-50 GW annual additions; SECI now sole REIA
items.quote: So there's a target to complete the 500 megawatt about 45 to 50 gigawatt per year.

items.statement: Promoter pledge release expected by March 2027 post COD of 250/370 MW projects
items.quote: Within 3 months after that, I think by March '27, all the pledge will be released by the bank.

items.statement: Sundrops Energia IPO filing imminent this financial year for BESS and battery manufacturing
items.quote: This year, as we told, this year, this financial year, we'll be doing the listing for Sundrops.

items.statement: Operating cash flow doubled to INR424 crores in FY26; capex funded by long-term debt
items.quote: Cash flow from operation activities improved to INR424 crores in FY '26 compared to INR208 crores in FY '25.

items.statement: ROE dip to be curtailed in FY27; targets return to prior levels by FY28
items.quote: Most probably this year we'll have a little bit -- we will curtail the drop this year itself. And next year, we'll see again ROE coming back to the earlier levels.

items.statement: Curtailment risk under discussion at CERC/transcos; no concrete deadline for resolution
items.quote: Yes, that is a dynamic decision, not a concrete decision has come from CERC level or some of the verdict has come from CERC level.

items.statement: BESS projects expected to complete in FY27 with revenue contribution starting FY27-28.
items.quote: That I think we'll complete it in this financial year most probably. And next year, '27, '28,'ll find the revenue getting clocked into our top line of Sundrop.

items.statement: BESS order book includes 440/890 MWh and 120/240 MWh signed orders with GUVNL as end customer.
items.quote: At present on the BESS or the Battery Energy Storage System, we have 2 major orders. We have 440/890 megawatt hours, which we have won the tender. Another one is public120/240-megawatt hours.

items.statement: Management reaffirmed medium-term organic revenue growth guidance of ~20% CAGR and targets 23-25% EBITDA margin over time.
items.quote: We are firmly on course to deliver on our medium-term guidance of 20% CAGR as we progress towards our 10x decadal growth vision.

items.statement: Gross margin pressure from verticalization investments expected to ease in ~1 year, with margin improvement visible in the second year.
items.quote: I believe in about a year, we should be able to achieve the level of verticalization and the level of intel that we need to develop across all the key geographies and hopefully, around that time onwards, we should see another year of bringing it back to better levels.

items.statement: Board approved preferential issue of ~7.4M warrants at INR 1,487 (~INR 11B) to Affle Holdings for M&A readiness; 25% upfront.
items.quote: our Board has approved a preferential issue of equity shares to strengthen our balance sheet. Post our shareholders' approval, our corporate promoter, Affle Holdings, will invest to acquire ~7.4 million warrants at INR 1,487, totaling approximately INR 11 billion, with 25% upfront payment.

items.statement: 13th consecutive quarter of sequential revenue growth; Q4 FY26 revenue INR 7.24B (+20.3% YoY), FY26 revenue INR 27.1B (+19.5% YoY).
items.quote: We concluded another year on a remarkable note, registering our 13th consecutive quarter of sequential topline growth despite a challenging macro environment. In Q4 FY2026, we delivered revenue of INR 7.24 billion, an increase of 20.3% y-o-y.

items.statement: FY26 EBITDA margin expanded 120bps to 22.5%; Q4 EBITDA margin 22.3% flat YoY. Gross margins under pressure from premium inventory investments.
items.quote: Our sustained focus on operational efficiency and profitable growth translated into EBITDA of INR 6.10 billion for the full year, registering a robust 26.3% y-o-y growth with a margin of 22.5% on an improvement of 120 basis points y-o-y.

items.statement: CPCU rate at INR 60.0 in Q4; management sees structural CPCU pricing growth over 10 years driven by premium conversions and LTV focus.
items.quote: Our CPCU business continued to scale, delivering 120.3 million conversions at a CPCU rate of INR 60.0, translating into CPCU revenues of INR 7.21 billion.

items.statement: Geopolitical headwinds in Q4 did not derail growth; CPCU model seen as resilient in recession as advertisers prioritize ROI.
items.quote: When recession happens, it's not that businesses stop. They find it harder to make revenue. In that time, they want to spend their advertising dollars with great prudence and careful measures to say that if I'm spending this ad money, I better get ROI.

items.statement: India & emerging markets 71.6% of revenue (+21.2% YoY); developed markets 28.4% (+18% YoY). CTV and digital OOH emerging but <10% focus.
items.quote: India and global emerging markets together contributed 71.6% of our revenues, while growing by 21.2% year-on-year. Our developed markets delivered a resilient performance, growing 18.0% year-on-year, and contributed 28.4% of our revenues in Q4 FY2026.

items.statement: Human vs non-human (agentic AI) filtration emerging as key differentiator; Affle holds patents since 2017. Competitors not addressing this.
items.quote: With the advent of agentic AI and the explosion of AI-generated apps or content on the Internet, this particular intellectual property or proposition or capability of Affle's 3i Consumer Platform Stack is becoming an outstanding differentiator.

items.statement: Warrants route chosen over QIP to demonstrate committed capital certainty for M&A negotiations; Affle Holdings funding source to be disclosed later.
items.quote: We already have a substantial amount of cash. When we are on a negotiation on the pricing with the target companies, there is a requirement to show the strength of the capital. If you need to take some leverages, you need to build up the capital for that.

items.statement: M&A pipeline: 4 targets shortlisted after evaluating 10+; aim to close meaningful deal within calendar year 2026. Focus on developed market sales force, advertiser relationships, and tech integrations.
items.quote: In the last earnings call also, I had mentioned that we have evaluated several companies - more than 10 and then we've shortlisted about 4 - where we are doing deeper due diligence, we are doing deeper assessments as well as negotiations.

items.statement: Operating cash flow INR 5.02B in FY26 (~25% 5-year CAGR); PAT margin 16.3%; ETR 18.6%.
items.quote: We achieved operating cash flows of INR 5.02 billion during the year, increasing by ~25% CAGR over the last 5 years. This underscores the quality of our earnings, our disciplined working capital management and our consistent ability to convert profitable growth into strong cash flows.

items.statement: GenAI apps emerging as new vertical; Affle experimenting with LLM platforms but focus is ecosystem-level integration with AI-generated apps.
items.quote: In the category G, soon we'll talk about GenAI apps as a vertical or as a category of advertisers, the new age GenAI apps, which will also need to do 2 things. One, they need to find the consumer so that they'll use their app and in order to do that, they'll spend ad budgets on a CPCU model with us.

items.statement: Revenue target of INR 3,000 crore by FY30 for NDR Auto; Bharat Seats target revised to INR 3,500 crore by FY30
items.quote: Bharat Seats maybe you can take a INR3,500 crore guidance by FY30.

items.statement: Order book increased by INR 200 crore to INR 650 crore, entirely from Maruti Suzuki; programs to execute over next 3 years and last 7-8 years
items.quote: So, the entire INR200 crore is from Maruti Suzuki.

items.statement: Current revenue ~INR 830-850 crore; order book of INR 650 crore added to current revenue gives visibility till FY30
items.quote: Our current revenue is about INR 830 crore, INR850 crore. This order book will add another INR650 crore to our revenue and then those programs will last for another 7 to 8 years.

items.statement: FY27 capex of INR 30-40 crore for new order book execution, over and above INR 150 crore for new product lines
items.quote: In addition to that, we are going to do another INR 40 to INR50 crore to execute our new order book.

items.statement: EBITDA margin of 11.5% sustainable; gross margin improvement from product mix and vendor volume discounts; commodities indexed
items.quote: Yes, that is sustainable.

items.statement: Seat premiumization (artificial leather, power seats, ventilated seats) to increase content per vehicle by 40-50% over next 5 years
items.quote: It goes model to model, but it should increase by about maybe 40% - 50% in the next 5 years.

items.statement: Demand intact; no supply chain issues faced; new programs (eVitara, 3 more projects) to drive similar revenue growth in FY27
items.quote: We have got eVitara which will come next full year and then we have got three more projects starting next year. So, I think we should likely have the similar revenue growth.

items.statement: Hayashi JV: INR 80 crore total approved project cost; INR 30 crore spent so far; phase-wise investment as orders materialize
items.quote: So, INR80 crore is the total project cost that we have approved. We ha ve currently spent, invested about INR10, INR15 crore each, which is about INR30 crore in it.

items.statement: No change in Bharat Seats shareholding; NDR Auto at 28%, family 17%, Suzuki 30%; cannot cross 74-75% promoter threshold
items.quote: So, I do not think we can cross the 74% threshold.

items.statement: New product orders secured: seat belt reminder, seat latch, seat insert (start Jan 2027); Hayashi JV has ambient lighting orders from Maruti Suzuki
items.quote: Seat belt reminder system, seat latch, and the seat insert , we already have orders for that. We will just be transferring the business to that. It starts 2027 January

items.statement: Cost increases mapped vs productivity and commodity per product; vendor price increases tracked with customer price increases
items.quote: We have mapped the cost increases versus productivity and commodity for each product and each component.

items.statement: Toyota expansion in Aurangabad: land acquired, Hayashi JV formed, seat business replication under bidding process
items.quote: We have currently acquired land in Aurangab ad for the Toyota expansion. We ha ve also did our joint venture with Hayashi for the Toyota expansion and we also want to replicate our seat business over there.

items.statement: Ambient lighting orders from Maruti Suzuki: revenue INR 10-20 crore initially; will scale with further empanelment
items.quote: The two ambient lighting orders that we ha ve got are relatively small orders. The top line should be anything between INR10 and INR20 crore for both.

items.statement: Operating cash flow positive at INR 37.12 crore; free cash flow reduced due to Delhi office (INR 12 cr), subsidiary support (INR 6 cr), MSME vendor payments
items.quote: We do not have a negative operating cashflow. There is a positive operating cashflow of 37.12 cr.

items.statement: FY27 revenue growth target 30-35% with operating EBITDA margin 10-10.5% and total EBITDA INR700 cr
items.quote: We remain committed to our aspirations of sustained revenue growth of 35% with a sustainable operating EBITDA margin of at least 10% to 10.5%, targeting INR700 crores of total EBITDA for the next year, FY '27.

items.statement: Export revenue target INR1,500 cr for FY27, up from INR1,200 cr in FY26
items.quote: My exports at INR372 crores give a good run rate of INR125 crores, which is again equivalent to the next year's target of about INR1,500 crores.

items.statement: PCB project capex INR800 cr over multiple years: INR400 cr phase 1 (INR50 cr spent, INR250 cr in FY27, INR100 cr FY28), phase 2 in FY29
items.quote: PCB-related, we said that we are planning to spend approximately $90 million, which is INR800 crores of capex over the year for this multilayer line kind of a PCB setup.

items.statement: Organic capex INR100-150 cr for FY27 excluding PCB project
items.quote: Apart from that, organic capex within the system, normally in the business, we are expecting INR100 crores to INR150 crores of capex this year.

items.statement: CCL, HDI and Flex PCB projects approved, additional INR800 cr capex between FY28-FY30
items.quote: So both put together, we will be spending another INR800 crores for those projects. But that project capex may get executed somewhere between FY '28 to FY '30.

items.statement: Order book INR6,600 cr as of March 2026, up from INR6,400 cr previous quarter; auto 29%, consumer 30%, industrial 24%, healthcare 5%, IT/railways 11%
items.quote: As on March end, we have about INR600 crores of total order book visibility together, of which auto is about 29%, consumer is about 30%, industrial vertical is about 24%, health care is about 5%, and IT and railways together is about 11% of Order book.

items.statement: FY26 operating EBITDA margin 11.3% (+270 bps YoY), Q4 FY26 11.9% vs 12.6% Q3 FY26 due to higher IT mix
items.quote: Operating EBITDA expanded 68% year-on-year basis to INR545 crores, with operating EBITDA margin improving 270 basis points to 11.3%.

items.statement: Conservative FY27 margin guidance 10.5-11% despite 12% FY26 exit rate due to geopolitical volatility and raw material cost pass-through lag
items.quote: Having delivered an EBITDA margin of 12%-odd this year, next year, we are guiding 10.5% to 11%, keeping this turmoil into account.

items.statement: Strong demand across auto, industrial, healthcare, IT/railways, defense; IT/railways grew 182% YoY in Q4, 74% FY26; healthcare to cross INR500 cr in FY27
items.quote: The demand environment across all key verticals: auto, industrial, health care and the emerging IT and railways and the defense and maritime business remains encouraging.

items.statement: ODM revenue grew 80% to INR825 cr (17% of revenue); target to sustain 17% mix in FY27 implying 30% ODM growth; exports 24-25% of revenue, grew 41%
items.quote: Our ODM revenue for the year is about 17%, substantially increased from 12% last year. Comin g to customer concentration. Our top 5 customers contribute around 34% of revenue, top 10 around 47%, top 20 around 63% of my revenue on a full year basis, FY '26.

items.statement: PCB capex funded via internal accruals, debt, and 25% JV partner contribution; net cash INR467 cr, gross cash INR820 cr; no cash shortfall expected
items.quote: This year for the PCB business, we will spending around INR250 crores and for the same it will partly funded through debt and partly through internal accruals and there is a JV partner also, 25% of this capex has to be funded by the JV partner also together.

items.statement: Working capital days improved from 69 to 63 (58 ex-Elcome); target further reduction but selective on customers; OCF INR290 cr (53% of EBITDA)
items.quote: Our working capital days improved from 69 days to 63 days on a year-on-year basis, reflecting better operational efficiency. Net working capital days, when we calculate, excluding Elcome, which we have recently acquired, it is actually 58 days.

items.statement: FY27 presales guidance set at INR5,000 crores, ~25% growth over FY26
items.quote: FY '27 guidance is INR5,000 crores. That's approximately a 25% growth.

items.statement: FY27 project launches guidance at INR8,000 crores GDV
items.quote: Project launches will be about INR8,000 crores this year

items.statement: FY27 business development acquisitions guidance at INR8,000+ crores GDV
items.quote: our acquisitions will be roughly about INR8,000-plus crores

items.statement: Gross debt-to-equity capped at 0.75:1 for FY27
