items.statement: Expect stronger recovery in Pipes in FY27 supported by increased government spending and infrastructure demand
items.quote: We expect prices to stabilize over the coming months and anticipate a stronger recovery in FY27, supported by increased government spending and infrastructure-led demand.

items.statement: Parador expects gradual recovery through FY27 driven by retail reboot and premium product launches
items.quote: Several corrective initiatives have already been implemented to improve operational performance, and we expect a gradual recovery through FY27.

items.statement: Nellore boards plant and Patna OPVC facility on track; brownfield expansions to add capacity in FY27
items.quote: The new boards plant we are setting up in Nellore, Andhra Pradesh is advancing well and is on track as far as defined execution milestones are concerned. Similarly, the OPVC facility in Patna is now fully commissioned.

items.statement: Pipes EBITDA margin expanded ~1,300 bps YoY in Q4 due to resin price spike and cost actions
items.quote: More importantly, the EBITDA margins expanded sharply by about 1,300 basis points year-on-year due to sustained cost actions, higher realization and some positive impact of inventory revaluation.

items.statement: Roofing input costs under pressure from rupee depreciation, freight, energy and cement; some price correction expected
items.quote: There is pressure on the input side from fibre perspective and from cement, which is a big raw material for us. So, there is some inflationary pressure on the input cost as well. We are confident that at least some part of this will be offset from price corrections in the market, hopefully.

items.statement: Roofing demand momentum improved in last 2-3 months driven by rural resilience and steel price premium
items.quote: What we are witnessing, and I can say that on the evidence of the last 2 to 3 months is there is good momentum on the demand front, certainly better than what it was last year and last couple of years, honestly.

items.statement: Construction Chemicals grew 58% YoY in Q4 (45% full year) including Clean Coats; ex-Clean Coats growth 25% full year
items.quote: Construction Chemical, probably the youngest part of our portfolio, is on a strong growth momentum. This segment, including Clean Coats, delivered growth of about 58% year-on-year in quarter 4 and 45% for the full year.

items.statement: Walls segment revenue grew 14% YoY in Q4 (13% full year) driven by 20-25% growth in Panels and Boards
items.quote: Revenue grew by 14% during the quarter to Rs. 161 crores, whereas full year revenue stood at Rs. 610 crores, reflecting a strong growth of 13%. This performance was primarily driven by Panels and Boards segment which delivered growth in the range of 20% to 25% during the year.

items.statement: Rs 74 cr impairment on Parador equity investment; residual equity value Rs 200 cr vs original Rs 273.5 cr
items.quote: I would also like to draw your attention on provision created for diminution in the equity investment in BirlaNu International GmBH amounting to Rs. 74 crores, which has been reported under exceptional items in the standalone financial statements for the quarter.

items.statement: Comfortable with additional Rs 200-250 cr debt at current equity base of Rs 1,100 cr
items.quote: See, if you see our equity is close to Rs. 1,100 crores at consol level, whereas debt structure is Rs. 850 crores. So, we are comfortable to another Rs. 200 crores, Rs. 250 crores at this point of time.

items.statement: BCG cost optimization benefits partially visible in Q4; full savings to materialize from FY27
items.quote: We are already seeing and some of it is visible in quarter 4 results, incremental benefits flowing through with the full savings set to materialize from FY27 onwards.

items.statement: FY27 consolidated revenue guidance of INR950 crores based on ~50% utilization of expanded ethanol capacity; confident of exceeding this number
items.quote: the top line guidance of an average of INR950 crores is also very conservative in nature. And we have factored in only about 50% capacity utilization of the expansion. So if all goes well, I think, we will far exceed our numbers.

items.statement: Ethanol division sustainable EBITDA margin guidance of 12-15% long-term; FY26 margin of 17% benefited from soft grain prices, byproduct value addition, and insurance claim
items.quote: on previous calls, I have maintained that we will achieve between 12% to 15% EBITDA in this division on a sustainable basis. However, this year's particular in nature because I think grain prices softened a little bit and we did do some value addition in our byproducts.

items.statement: No large capex planned for FY27; up to INR20 crores for byproduct value addition project in ethanol division
items.quote: We don't have any large capex envisaged for this financial year. We're looking at investing up to INR20 crores in a value addition project in our byproduct stream in the ethanol division. But other than that, we have no large capex plans.

items.statement: Received PSU OMC order for 47.9 kiloliters (INR400 crores) for current ESY cycle ending 31 Oct 2026; expect more orders from private and PSU OMCs in ongoing ESY
items.quote: the orders that we received is for the ongoing ESY in the cycle one tender of PSU OMCs alone. And this is till 31st October of this year. That's the ESY cycle, ethanol sugar year, if you track the sector, it's from 1st November to 31st October. So this is the order that we've already received.

items.statement: Passed on packaging cost increases; rice bran oil prices up but olive oil prices down, managing edible oil input costs well
items.quote: we have passed it on to some extent. For example, there's a huge increase in packaging material costs. So that we have passed on. Raw material wise, in the food category, we don't see as much inflation. On the edible oil side, while rice bran prices have gone up, olive oil prices have come down.

items.statement: Consumer division revenue grew 2% in FY26 but Q4 momentum stronger; expect faster growth ahead driven by distribution expansion, new products (pasta, hing) and premiumization
items.quote: Consumer division last year is at about 2% revenue growth. But I think going forward, it will grow faster because in Q4 we have grown faster and the momentum is now built.

items.statement: Consumer portfolio: 90% oils, 10% food products; target INR500 crores medium-term (INR300-350 crores oils + INR150 crores food); channel mix 50% modern trade, 40% general trade, 8-10% army canteens
items.quote: I don't see any reason why this segment for us should not get to INR500 crores in the medium term. This will be propelled by growth within the oil basket as well as food products. So I think oil can easily grow to about INR300 crores to INR350 crores and add about INR150 crores from food in the medium term.

items.statement: Evaluated food sector acquisition opportunities but nothing finalized; will inform market when concrete
items.quote: We've evaluated a few opportunities in the food sector, but nothing that we have firmed up yet. And we will let the community know as and when.

items.statement: Auditor change was planned succession over 2-3 years; new auditors already audited Modi Biotech subsidiary
items.quote: this was always planned. I think this is more of a succession which we started this journey started, I think, two to three years back. So the auditors who have been appointed were already auditing our Modi Biotech results for the last two, three years.

items.statement: Expect full utilization of Dahej and Roha facilities in FY27
items.quote: As far as '26, '27 is concerned, then we expect full utilization of both our Dahej and Roha facilities in this financial year.

items.statement: Manufactured sales EBITDA margin at 24-25%, expected to rise further with value-added product growth
items.quote: So if you see the actual EBITDA margin on manufactured sales, it would be close to 24%, 25%, which was what the target of the company was as far as synthetic food colors and certain other value-added products, which we are now increasing the sales from time to time.

items.statement: CoatIcon pharma coating capex INR5-12 cr; new product line capex INR75-85 cr in first phase, mostly spent in FY27
items.quote: On the pharma, on the Coat Icon range, on the scale-up of the manufacturing of that particular product line, our outflow is expected to be between INR5 crores to INR12 crores. And with regards to our other new products, which we wish to introduce, the capex outflow is expected to be between INR75 crores to INR85 crores

items.statement: High-value product contribution currently 5%, expected to reach 10-12% in FY27
items.quote: Currently, the contribution of the high-margin, high-value products in our total product portfolio mix is around 5% and increasing gradually. In the coming year 2026, '27, we expect it to go to around in the range of 10% to 12% or it may be higher also.

items.statement: Demand remains highly robust for FY27; geopolitical instability currently suppressing some export markets
items.quote: Now with regards to the outlook, which you have asked for '26, '27, the demand of the company remains highly robust.

items.statement: Middle East conflict and economic distress in Iran, Bangladesh, Philippines reducing color demand; US tariff volatility stabilized
items.quote: Countries like Bangladesh have also been, for decades, a good market, which has again been disturbed since last 2 years. They don't have any money to buy food or rice or diesel, what they will buy color. So there are several such markets, wherein the economies are teetering right now.

items.statement: New Dahej project phase 1 targets INR125-150 cr sales at INR75-85 cr capex; commissioning in 18 months (mid FY28)
items.quote: We have already said that we'll be investing around INR75 crores to INR85 crores for the capex for this project, which is going to be taking off at Dahej. And in the first phase, we will hope to get about anywhere between INR125 crores to INR150 crores of sales at capex.

items.statement: US FDA certification cost $1/kg expensed in Q4 FY26, will be passed on to customers
items.quote: A part of it has also gone towards the U.S. FDA certification costs wherein we are paying $1 per kilo to U.S. FDA and then when we sell those products to our customers, we are passing it on to them.

items.statement: FY26 consolidated EBITDA margin improved to 20.52% from 17.91%; net profit margin 12.93%
items.quote: The EBITDA for year 2025-'26 stood at INR78 crores compared to INR68 crores in the previous financial year. Accordingly, the EBITDA margins improved from 17.91% to 20.52%.

items.statement: Export subvention scheme withdrawn Dec 2025 increased finance cost; interest coverage fell to 16.75% from 28.27%
items.quote: Just you might have seen the difference on the interest cost of the company, which is due to the subvention on export finance, which has been withdrawn by the Indian government as of December 2025.

items.statement: CoatIcon tablet coating in aggressive sampling with pharma cos globally; approval cycle ~6 months
items.quote: The CoatIcon tablet coating system, like we said, is in the aggressive phase of sampling and approval from several pharmaceutical companies in India and across the globe. And the general time cycle required by them is close to 6 months' time.

items.statement: No US ban on synthetic food colors; all exported colors FDA-approved and batch-tested
items.quote: The U.S. was never planning to ban synthetic food colors. So that perception is completely false. There was no plan to ban synthetic food colors.

items.statement: Order book at INR 1,628 crore as of March 31, 2026, providing ~2 years execution visibility from continuing operations
items.quote: As of March 31, 2026, our order book stood at INR1,628 crores, which remains healthy and provides the visibility for close to 2 years of execution from continuing operations.

items.statement: Core services order intake grew 32% YoY in FY26; core services order backlog up ~40% YoY
items.quote: Core orders, the backbone have risen by 32% from FY24-25, with the revenue for the same period witnessed 12% upside and for this year 15% above the budget for the core services.

items.statement: Underlying EBITDA margin (excl. one-offs) was 11% for FY26 at entity level; Q4 underlying EBITDA margin ~18%
items.quote: I'm happy to share that excluding the one-offs, your company delivered 11% EBITDA at the entity level in the current financial year, reflected solely by the operational performance.

items.statement: Expect 85-90% of March 31, 2026 order backlog to be executed in FY27 (core services are short-cycle, completing within 12 months)
items.quote: So typically these are short cycle orders which gets complete within 12 months. So the order in hand that you see as on, say, 31st March 2026, expect around 85% to 90% of that to be executed in FY'26-'27.

items.statement: Target addressable market for core services estimated at INR 3,500-4,000 crore; current market share ~18%
items.quote: Market size, it will be about INR3,500 crores to INR4,000 crores as a target market.

items.statement: Durgapur manufacturing facility demerger to JSW Energy on track; target completion within calendar year 2026 (definitely within 12 months from March 31, 2026)
items.quote: The realistic timelines, well within 12 months is definitely there. The target is to close within this calendar year, that's the target, but I can say that within 12 months from, say, 31st March of 2026 is definitely the expectation.

items.statement: FGD-EP order book reduced due to termination of Jaypee Bina and Nigrie contracts (INR 775 crore) and revised emission norms limiting near-term FGD ordering
items.quote: This reduction is driven by the termination of two FGD EP contracts of Jaypee Bina and Nigrie.

items.statement: Board recommended dividend of INR 7 per equity share (70% of face value), highest in at least 10 years, subject to AGM approval
items.quote: We are pleased to also announce that the board has recommended dividend payout of 70% of the face value, which is subject to the approval of the shareholders of the company at the ensuing Annual General Meeting.

items.statement: Surplus cash (INR 450 crore) lent to group cash pool at 5.5-6.35% yield, benchmarked to HSBC rates, reviewed by board and auditors
items.quote: The range, then you have two points, one on the rate and two on the safety of this lending. So, the rates vary, of course, as the time goes as also the benchmark rates change, but it remains in the range of 5.5 to 6.35% during the year

items.statement: Strategy shift to asset-light, service-led model: exited hydro/gas, demerging Durgapur; core services now 18% market share with 25% 4-year CAGR
items.quote: As a result of that, at least for this year growth Puneet mentioned 32% in core orders in particular, but also over four years, the CAGR is 25%.

items.statement: BHEL settlement fully closed: received INR 343 crore in FY26; all obligations discharged, ECL reversals of INR 116 crore (FY) and INR 44 crore (Q4) are one-off
items.quote: pursuant to the settlement agreement signed with BHEL earlier this year, the company has successfully received INR 343 crores in the financial year 25-26. With receipt of the above-stated amount, all the obligation from your company in respect to the projects covered under the settlement agreement stand closed

items.statement: Expects industry to grow at strong single-digit in FY27; TVS aims to grow ahead of industry
items.quote: See, we are expecting a good single-digit growth on the industry this year. And we are seeing good growth momentum.

items.statement: Capex for FY27 likely around INR 3,500 crores including INR 2,000 crores for product development and INR 1,000 crores+ for 1.5 million capacity expansion
items.quote: All put together, the capex for next year for TVS Motor will be likely to be around INR3,500 crores.

items.statement: International demand extremely strong; unable to meet current demand; 15% increase in logistics lead times
items.quote: Actually, the demand is so high for us, we are not able to meet the demand today.

items.statement: Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin at 13.1%; aims to continue EBITDA margin improvement journey through scale, mix and cost reduction
items.quote: During the quarter, company's operating EBITDA was at INR 1,679 crores as against last year INR1,172 crores. Company registered a PBT of INR1,358 crores during this quarter as against INR851 crores in Q4 last year.

items.statement: Commodity inflation estimated at 3-5% of revenue; passed on 35% of cost increase via price hikes; will use mix of cost reduction, product mix, scale and selective price increases
items.quote: See the commodity, I think this is unprecedented. I think it is around 3% to 5% because as we speak, there are challenges, but we were able to increase prices 35% of the price increases we were able to offset by increasing prices.

items.statement: Domestic demand strong across EV, scooters, premium segments; economy segment challenged; rural supported by 16% higher reservoir levels
items.quote: What is most important is our demand both in domestic and international for all our models are extremely good.

items.statement: Scooter share at 38% including EV, targeting >40%; strong performance from Jupiter, Ntorq, iQube, Orbiter, Ronin, Apache; 3-wheeler EV and CNG cargo gaining traction
items.quote: Currently SSP, including EV, the scooter category share is almost 38%. And according to me, that is likely to go over 40%.

items.statement: Supply chain challenges: gas availability, raw material delays, Tier 2 labor shortages; geopolitical risks from West Asia conflict; 15% longer export lead times
items.quote: We have also gone through similar situation in the past. Company has also taken many initiatives to further strengthen our cost reduction, improving the product mix, also taking price increases wherever we are able to look at.

items.statement: FY26 total investments INR 2,400 crores (mainly Norton, TVS Credit, Dubai); FY27 investments lower at ~INR 500-600 crores less than FY26
items.quote: Next year, the investments will be much lower. It will be maybe another INR500 crores, INR600 crores lower than this INR 2,400.

items.statement: EV 2-wheeler monthly capacity currently ~40,000, targeting 50,000/month; EV revenue ~INR 5,000 crores in FY26; penetration rose from 6.2% to 6.6%
items.quote: EV Revenue. You have to give me a minute. Just let me look at it. About 5,000 crores.

items.statement: Hyundai Motor JV for electric 3-wheeler: Hyundai leads design/R&D, TVS provides electric platform and 3-wheeler expertise; timeline and financial details not disclosed
items.quote: TVS Motor has recently signed a joint development agreement with Hyundai Motor Company to commercialize an electric 3-wheeler.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 expected to post very good growth better than industry; supply chain issues improving, confident of recovery by end of May
items.quote: Things are becoming better. This month is going to be better. And we are confident that Q1, we will post a very good growth better than the industry.

items.statement: Norton launches (Manx, Manx R, Atlas, Atlas GT) key for FY27; Q2 FY27 critical; some models to be made in Hosur, some in Solihull
items.quote: '26-'27 is going to be very, very important year, especially the Q2 of '26-'27.

items.statement: International revenue Q4 FY26 INR 2,999 crores; spare parts revenue INR 1,122 crores; channel inventory normalizing to 21-30 days range
items.quote: Q4, we're at almost INR3,000 crores -- INR2,999 crores. And spare parts, total spare parts is -- overall spare parts is about INR1,122 crores.

items.statement: Management is very bullish on FY27 and expects to beat all prior benchmarks, but declines to provide numeric guidance per board instruction.
items.quote: If I were to give any guidance, would say that as team as everyone here, we are actually very bullish right now. So, we are very bullish in this year. And I feel that, you know, by all benchmarks, we should beat everything that we have done this.

items.statement: Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin at 14.5%, PAT margin at 13.6%; 9 of last 10 quarters EBITDA positive, 3 successive quarters PAT positive.
items.quote: On profitability, our EBITDA is at 14.5% and PAT at 13.6% for the quarter. Positive EBITDA is 9 out of the last 10 quarters. Three successive quarters of positive PAT.

items.statement: Goodwill impairment test completed in Q4; auditors concluded carrying value of ~INR 190 crores is fine, no impairment needed.
items.quote: We have completed that. And our auditors have concluded that, you know, the carrying value is fine right now, and there was no need to invest, actually, any of their investment.

items.statement: Management targets INR 100 crores quarterly revenue this fiscal year
items.quote: I think this is the year we go for it.

items.statement: FraudZap has three paying telco customers onboarded via intermediary
items.quote: So currently, from that perspective, we have three customers.

items.statement: Team of LLMs product (FraudZap) completed POCs with 2-3 customers; commercialization delayed by GPU hardware constraints
items.quote: We have actually completed the POCs. We are in conversations with at least, two or three customers to make it commercial now, actually, in this quarter.

items.statement: Middle East conflict may delay new purchase decisions; existing projects being offshored to India to mitigate delivery risk
items.quote: In terms of new decisions or new purchase decisions, that's where we see a slight risk of customers delaying decisions.

items.statement: Revenue mix comprises license, implementation, and support (AMC/MS); not 100% subscription
items.quote: So, there are three distinct pieces to how the revenue moves for a customer.

items.statement: Identified four growth engines: traditional telco horizontal expansion, Agentic AI/MS replacement, new-age leakage vectors (FraudZap), and telco adjacencies (mobile money, MVNO, IoT assurance, data centers) with $4.3M new TAM
items.quote: If I actually look at the TAM, this is 4.3 million of TAMs that did not exist even two years ago.

items.statement: Rupee depreciation benefits USD/EUR-denominated revenue; customers increasingly demand local currency contracts, causing negotiation delays
items.quote: Obviously, when we measure our performance, rupee depreciation helps us only because most of our contracts are in USD.

items.statement: FY27 operating revenue growth target: top quartile among peers; EBITDA margin guidance retained at 24-28%
items.quote: So, what we are saying is that we will be in the top quartile of growth in FY '27. We would be in the EBITDA range of 24% to 28%.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 sequential revenue growth expected to be stronger than Q4 FY26
items.quote: we expect that it should definitely be better than what we did in Q4, if you look at the sequential growth

items.statement: Q4 FY26 capex increased due to investments in computers and networking equipment
items.quote: CapEx is up in Q4. This is primarily due to investments in computers and networking equipment.

items.statement: Q4 FY26 new deal wins (ACV) at USD 46 million; FY26 total ACV ~USD 170 million, up 24% YoY
items.quote: New deal wins for Q4 were USD 46 million, reflecting steady momentum and a strong signal of client confidence in our capabilities going into FY '27.

items.statement: FY26 operating EBITDA margin expanded ~132 bps YoY to ~27.3%; Q4 operating EBITDA margin 25.7%, down 15 bps QoQ due to headcount addition and travel costs
items.quote: Overall EBITDA, including other income, is down 42 bps, while full year EBITDA has expanded by 132 bps.

items.statement: Wage hike impact in Q1 FY27 expected similar to prior years at ~300-350 bps margin headwind
items.quote: the wage hike impact in Q1 will be similar. So typically, about 300 to 350 basis points.

items.statement: Pipeline strong across verticals; Agentic AI deployments converting from pilots to meaningful projects; first large-scale Agentic AI win in Q4 with deployment starting Q1 FY27
items.quote: We secured our first large -scale Agentic AI win in Q4, with deployments planned for Q1 FY '27 and thereafter.

items.statement: Analytics & automation book reached USD 90 million in FY26; expected to grow faster than company average in FY27
items.quote: Analytics and automation is now a USD 90 million bo ok. That is a significant milestone, and this area will continue to attract focused investment and management attention.

items.statement: AI deflationary pressure on contract values acknowledged as possible but difficult to quantify; competitive landscape may contribute
items.quote: Some of it maybe, Abhishek, I wouldn't say deflationary pressures because of AI, but the competitive landscape like I think that was to the previous question. So , a combination of that may put some deflationary pressures.

items.statement: Capital allocation: buybacks to remain preferred over dividends
items.quote: Buybacks will continue to remain the preferred option.

items.statement: Top 10 client concentration reduced to 59% from 63-64%, indicating portfolio diversification
items.quote: Top 10 client concentration has come down to 59% from 63% to 64%, a healthy sign of portfolio diversification that reduces concentration risk as we scale.

items.statement: FY26 free cash flow INR 7,560 million, up 41% YoY; OCF/EBITDA 75%, highest in 5 years
items.quote: In FY '26, we generated INR 8,729 million of cash from operations and a free cash flow of INR 7,560 million, 33% and 41% higher than the previous year.

items.statement: FY27 guidance deferred to Q1 FY27 earnings announcement due to geopolitical uncertainty and volatile demand environment
items.quote: Given the evolving demanding environment and continued uncertainty, the company has decided that it will provide its financial year '27 guidance during the quarter 1 financial year '27 earnings announcement once we have a better clarity on how the market conditions are faring out.

items.statement: Tooling business targets doubling mold capacity to ~300 molds/year over next 3 years
items.quote: And gradually in the next 3 years, we will try to double this capacity. So maybe in 3 years, we are planning roughly around 300-odd molds per year, more or less 1 mold in every 1.5 days.

items.statement: Expect FY27 margins to improve driven by capacity utilization rising to 80-82% and operational efficiencies including solar energy adoption
items.quote: So, that will drive all the gross margins and everything. And second factor will be the operational efficiencies that we are planning to do. Right now, although all the inflationary costs, raw material costs have increased, but once all this stabilizes, we have some certain countermeasures to reduce our expenses like i

items.statement: 50% of raw material cost increases from West Asia conflict covered by customer pass-through agreements; balance under discussion
items.quote: And out of that, almost 50% is already covered with the customer. We have the pass-on policy with the customer. That we are discussing -- we are in the discussion with the customer how to take care with that because currently, the situation is quite fluid.

items.statement: Delayed model SOPs now started production in Q4 FY26; 90% of new FY27 model launches in SUV segment reducing entry-level sedan exposure
items.quote: Those models have started production now. That is why you see the increase in quarter 4 numbers, which will continue for this '26, '27 financial year also. And along with that, there will be certain new model start-ups also happening in this financial year.

items.statement: Aftermarket business grew 36% in FY26 with 147 distributors and 1,264 SKUs; expects continued >25% CAGR growth in FY27
items.quote: The aftermarket business continued to deliver robust growth momentum during the financial year '26, recording an impressive growth of 36% over the previous year.

items.statement: Geopolitical uncertainties, West Asia conflict logistics disruptions, and volatile raw material prices create uncertain operating environment
items.quote: Looking ahead, while our order pipeline and customer engagements remain encouraging across all the 5 businesses, the external operating environment continues to remain dynamic and volatile due to the ongoing geopolitical uncertainties, the disruptions and the logistics-related challenges arising from the West Asia conf

items.statement: Divested JV stake for INR100 crores (invested INR48.5 crores over 10 years); net debt reduced to INR103 crores, gross debt ~INR195 crores maintained for strategic needs
items.quote: The stake has now been divested for a total consideration of INR100 crores, representing a significant value realization for the company.

items.statement: Battery business expects full recovery in FY27 with 100% plant utilization and profitability at PBT level; Q4 losses reduced to INR40 lakhs from INR1.2 crores
items.quote: So this year, based on what orders we executed in quarter 4, in financial year '27, we expect a full recovery of this business. And based on the contracts that we already have with the customers and whatever things are being discussed, we expect that the whole plant and machinery will be 100% utilized in this year, fin

items.statement: Q4 FY26 standalone EBITDA margin improved to 13% YoY (ex-wage code impact) vs 11% prior year
items.quote: And quarter 4 also, you can see that on a stand-alone basis, if you remove the impact of the wage code, then we have improved the margins to 13% EBITDA compared to 11% in the previous -- on a year-on-year basis.

items.statement: Content per vehicle ranges INR2,500-3,500 average, up to INR8,000-10,000 high end; 78% revenue from vehicles <5 years old
items.quote: On an average, it ranges somewhere between INR2,500 to INR3,500 per vehicle. And on the upper side, it goes up to INR8,000 to INR10,000. And on the lower side, it goes up to INR1,000 per vehicle.

items.statement: Capex for FY27 to be funded from internal accruals; debt levels maintained around current levels
items.quote: Rest capex would be done from the internal accruals only and we will keep the debt level around this level only for this financial year.

items.statement: FY27 consolidated revenue target of 500+ crores with 40% from India (200 crores) and 60% from UAE
items.quote: For FY27, we are considering total overall (500+) crores. In that 40% will be from India.

items.statement: FY27 EBITDA margin target of 17.5% to 18% at consolidated level
items.quote: I think we will maintain around 17.5% to 18% EBITDA. And also, the UAE facade business we have there, there is also a good order book position. So, maybe this will impact at a consolidated 1%.

items.statement: UAE expansion machines ordered, installation delayed by one quarter due to geopolitics, expected Q2/Q3 FY27 commissioning
items.quote: We had already considered some expansions in UAE where we had already ordered some machines which are yet to be installed. Because of this geopolitical, it was delayed by one quarter. So, we are expecting that in Q2 or Q3, we will be installing these machines.

items.statement: Raw material cost pass-through of 80-90% to customers, potential 1-1.5% EBITDA margin impact in UAE
items.quote: But I think we are able to transfer the incremental cost, about 80% to 90% to the customer. So, there will be a little bit of margin impact on EBITDA, maybe 1% or 1.5%.

items.statement: Float glass prices increased 7-8% in last 2 months due to energy/gas cost surcharge, being passed to customers in new quotations
items.quote: See last 2 months there is an increase of around 8% in the glass prices because of the energy cost or the gas cost has been increased. So, they had added the energy surcharge further. So, 7% to 8% is the glass price increase.

items.statement: India capacity utilization targets: Silvassa tempering 75%, IG >50%, lamination 90-95%; Glasstech tempering >50%, IG/lamination ~30%
items.quote: The Silvassa, the tempering capacity, more or less it will be in the range of 75%. IG we are expecting more than 50% this year. Lamination, we are expecting 90% to 95%. And Taloja and Erode together, we are expecting that tempering should go more than 50% and IG and laminate will contribute around 30%.

items.statement: Target 2x top-line growth and mid-teen EBITDA margin under Vision 2030
items.quote: we, as a company wants to grow in the top line at least 2x. And of course, one of the large and biggest focus that we wanted to have that we take our bottom line or the EBITDA percentages mid-teen and above.

items.statement: Cameroon export order executing in FY27 with maintenance component
items.quote: presently, we are charging Cameroon. And we are expecting few for this. We are exporting wagons to Cameroon now in this financial year primarily. That's also a substantial large order. And that also comes with maintenance.

items.statement: Wagon order book now ~70% private vs Indian Railways; expanding into signaling (Kavach), propulsion, metro, defense, digital (Invariz.ai)

items.quote: In fact, this year, in itself, we have planned for about between INR 680 crore to INR 700 crores of CAPEX to cater to all of our new businesses that we have won, new plants, new machines, so on and so forth.
