items.statement: IV plant EBITDA margin target 17-18% for FY27
items.quote: Going forward on an annualized basis, we expect EBITDA margins of around 17% to 18%.

items.statement: IV plant capacity 60 million bottles annually; 5 products approved, 18 in pipeline
items.quote: The capacity for the whole year is 60 million on annualized basis.

items.statement: Tablet portfolio growing faster than injectables; injectable 10-12%, tablet 7-8%, nutraceutical 8-9% growth in FY27
items.quote: Growth is coming majorly from the injectable side and tablet also coming to equally. 10%-12% growth will come from injectable and tablet is 7% to 8%. And nutraceutical will also ramp up this year, 8% to 9%.

items.statement: Export demand robust and stable across key markets; Middle East logistics disruption in March 2026 now resolving via alternative routes
items.quote: The pharmaceutical environment across a key export market remains robust with stable demand and healthy business activity during the quarter.

items.statement: Able to pass on input cost increases; no long-term fixed-price contracts with buyers
items.quote: Yes, we are able to pass on because we don't have a long-term contract with our buyers wherein we are stuck for the price fixation. So, our price part is open depending on the international price revisions and rates.

items.statement: Prague nutraceutical JV has good order book for current year; revenue EUR 500-600k last year
items.quote: And this year we have a good order book in Prague and we are doing healthy business there.

items.statement: Negotiating to increase stake in Prague nutraceutical JV from 45% to majority; timeline uncertain
items.quote: Currently, our parent Sanjivani owns 45% in that JV and we are under negotiation from majority state but it is yet to happen. When it will be happen we will be announcing it.

items.statement: Receivable days improved to 65-70 days in FY26; targeting 55-60 days going forward
items.quote: We would be in the range of 55 to 60 in the coming periods.

items.statement: Middle East & Africa contributes 40-45% of export revenue
items.quote: It's in the range of 40% to 45%.

items.statement: IV plant: 2 million bottles sold in Q3+Q4 FY26 for INR 3.5 crore revenue; 5 products approved, 6 of 18 pipeline products expected to contribute in FY27
items.quote: So, 2 million bottles is contributing a revenue of around INR 3.5 crores.

items.statement: FY2027 capex expected to be in the ballpark of FY2026 (Rs.31,000 Cr India ex-passive), give or take a little bit
items.quote: our sense is that we will be in the ballpark of this year, give or take a little bit.

items.statement: Airtel Business ended FY2026 with strong order book growth of 17%
items.quote: we ended the year with a strong order book growth of 17% in FY2026.

items.statement: India EBITDAaL margin (ex-passive) improved 3.1% YoY to 51.7% in FY2026; Q4 margin at 52%, up 20 bps QoQ
items.quote: India EBITDAaL excluding passive, came in at about Rs.72,500 Crores, growing around 18% and delivered a 3.1% improvement and stood at 51.7%.

items.statement: Geopolitical crisis impacting international roaming, capex (INR depreciation), gas supply restrictions lowering tower build-outs, and energy prices; mitigating via war on waste
items.quote: There are a few areas of our operations, which are seeing impact including international roaming, capex on account of INR depreciation, restriction on gas supply affecting galvanizing industry in turn leading to lower tower build-outs. The other obvious impact is energy price increase.

items.statement: Bharti Telecom aims to reach 51%+ controlling stake in Airtel over next decade using dividends and buybacks
items.quote: my own wish is that in the next, it is hard to put in years on it , in the next decade as I , kind of, come to a point where I hand over the reins to the next generation as shareholders, Bharti Telecom should get back to controlling shareholding- 51% or just over 50%.

items.statement: Financial services allocation of Rs 20,000 Cr over 5 years, with Rs 14,000 Cr from Airtel, likely to be significantly less
items.quote: the total amount that we are looking at allocating in the next five years , we have stated Rs. 20,000 Crores, of which Rs.14,000 Crores has to come from Airtel. It looks like it will be probably significantly less than that

items.statement: Airtel Africa stake target increased to 90% from current 78% via buybacks and potential block purchases
items.quote: Ambition for Airtel should be whatever is allowed to go up to 90%, one day should get there and that is being ably helped by Airtel Africa's own buyback program.

items.statement: Combined India-Africa customer target of 800 million (500M India, 300M Africa) across mobile, home, digital and financial services
items.quote: we will get to a 800 million customers by way of mobile, home broadband, our digital services, our financial services and both between India and Africa , getting to 500 million here and 300 million in Africa is a dream which is visible.

items.statement: Wireless capex at 16% of sales, a decade low; will spend optimally for 5G densification if needed, not chasing a target
items.quote: 16% is a derived number , as Gopal said , the core would be funded completely , we will ensure it is funded , so it has moderated significantly . Yes, it is one of the lowest as percentage sales , also in absolute terms it is very low, but if tomorrow we need to do higher 5G densification, we will not shy away

items.statement: B2B connectivity has very high margins; CPaaS and digital businesses have lower margins; focus on growing absolute EBITDA and profit faster
items.quote: connectivity, we will always continue to have very high margins , CPaaS will have lower margins and digital businesses will have lower margins. Our effort has to be to grow the topline faster and grow the absolute EBITDA, absolute profit faster.

items.statement: FWA chipset and memory prices risen sharply in last 3-4 months, making FWA much more expensive than fiber; pivoted to fiber-first strategy
items.quote: the rising prices of chipsets and memory, particularly on fixed wireless access and if you recall, like a year ago when we doubled down on fixed wireless access, the cost to connect to home was more or less the same as fiber. That has fundamentally changed in the last three to four months. The fixed wireless access has

items.statement: ARPU growth levers: postpaid penetration, international roaming, consumption upgrades within current pricing architecture; substantial headroom seen
items.quote: levers of postpaid penetration within our base , which we feel needs a much larger unlock . International roaming, we will see how that plays out this year , but even upgrades within the consumption baskets of our customers and the data that they are consuming, we continue to be very optimistic

items.statement: Homes ARPU bottoming out over last two quarters; acquisition ARPU not declining; focus on expanding base and convergence
items.quote: some of our quarter-on-quarter ARPUs are kind of bottoming out, which trend is, we are beginning to see in the last two quarters.

items.statement: Enterprise order book grew 17% YoY; commodity messaging business flat to declining; connectivity growing faster than industry low single digits
items.quote: the order book has grown 17% , which is quite heartening to hear

items.statement: Regulatory charge in Hexacom Q4 from changed interpretation of existing issues, not new demand; prudent provisioning with auditors and Board
items.quote: It was an existing thing. The interpretation of that existing thing has been changed and accordingly it has been provided for.

items.statement: Bharti Hexacom dividend increased to Rs 18/share from Rs 10; committed to progressively increasing payout
items.quote: The Board recommended a dividend of Rs.18 per share as compared to Rs.10 per share last year , in line with our philosophy of progressive payout.

items.statement: Data centers built with latest cooling, power efficiency, standard toolkit; using few hundred GPUs for internal AI needs, not GPU-as-a-service
items.quote: our data centers are being built with the latest technologies in terms of cooling capabilities, power efficiency and also a standard toolkit on the build out, which is really world class.

items.statement: Hexacom Q4 revenue Rs 2,414 Cr (+2.3% QoQ), EBITDAaL Rs 1,155 Cr (47.9% margin), net adds 370k, smartphone adds 478k, ARPU Rs 252 (Rs 257-258 EDB basis)
items.quote: we delivered another quarter of strong performance with revenue of Rs. 2414 Crores, growing 2.3% sequentially. EBITDAaL for the quarter came in at over Rs. 1155 Crores with a margin of 47.9%.

items.statement: EBITDA and PBT expected to grow ahead of revenue in coming quarters
items.quote: With integration now largely behind us, we expect our EBITDA and PBT to grow ahead of revenue in the coming quarters.

items.statement: Margin expansion plan on track for Express division with pricing actions improving RPKG
items.quote: Our margin expansion plan is on track on the Express side of business. And we are very comfortable the way we have kind of executed it.

items.statement: Fuel price hike pass-through mechanism in contracts and transparent monthly DPH percentage announced to customers
items.quote: We have a very transparent diesel price hike pass-through mechanism, which is already up on our website, customers can refer to it any time, and that kind of allows them to predictably calculate what the pass-through will be also. And also monthly, we announce what is going to be the DPH percentage applicable on their

items.statement: Plan to add 0.5 million sq ft warehouse space in FY27 largely on asset-light operating lease model
items.quote: In the next year, if you see on the expansion bit, we have a plan to add 0.5 million square feet additional on the warehouse space and that would be done largely on an asset-light approach.

items.statement: Express growth driven by surface business with focus on auto, engineering, pharma and diversified industries sectors
items.quote: Surface will be the growth driver on the product side with tonnage as a focus area. And the sectors that are essentially driving this is auto and engineering, pharma and also diversified industries.

items.statement: Consultative Logistics warehouse space at 8 million sq ft as of March 2026
items.quote: Moving on to the Consultative Logistics business, the total warehouse space under management stood at 8 million square feet as on March 2026.

items.statement: EBITDA margin improved from 10% to 11% in FY26 with commitment to progressive improvement
items.quote: Our EBITDA has shown an improvement from 10% to 11% we have achieved in this year and progressively, we are committed towards that value creation and enhancement of shareholders' value.

items.statement: E-commerce and quick commerce business on CL side serves top 3 players in each segment with sort, fulfilment and cross-dock centers
items.quote: If you draw a list of the top 3 e-commerce players in the country, we do the business with them. If you draw the list of the top 3 quick commerce companies in the country, we do business with them.

items.statement: Cautious on near-term outlook due to geopolitical scenario including West Asia crisis
items.quote: Looking ahead, while we are cautious on the near-term outlook due to the current geopolitical scenario, we remain focused on efficiency-led profitable growth.

items.statement: Allcargo Global listing approvals received from exchanges and SEBI; revised information memorandum to be filed in 2 weeks; listing expected in about a month
items.quote: We've received the necessary approvals from both exchanges and SEBI as well day before yesterday. And all we need to do now is file the revised information memorandum with authorities with the audited annual financials and we can expect the listing to happen in about a month's time from now on.

items.statement: PBT pre-exceptional items improved 96% in FY26 with growth buildup visible in next quarter
items.quote: If you see the improvement at the PBT level pre exceptional items, you can very well see, there is a 96% improvement, which has already happened in this year. So, the buildup of growth is already in place. And if you see going next quarter, that will be visible in terms of the entire contribution.

items.statement: Onboarded Amit Chhari as Chief of Operations and Samir Ahuja as Chief of Sales for Express division to scale business and enhance operational excellence
items.quote: We have recently onboarded, Mr. Amit Chhari as Chief of Operations, Express division. He is a transformative leader with deep expertise in B2B Express Logistics with the market leader, in network strategy and large-scale operations. Simultaneously, we have also onboarded Mr. Samir Ahuja as Chief of Sales, Express Divis

items.statement: Gross margins expected to remain in the 33-33.5% range in FY27, similar to FY26, as tariff normalizes from 50% to 10% and C&I accounting impact persists.
items.quote: So this margin range of 33.5% or 33% will remain in the next financial year as well.

items.statement: Capex guidance for FY27 is similar to FY26 at ~INR330 crores, focused on India and U.S. capacity expansion; long-term run-rate ~INR250 crores/year tied to depreciation.
items.quote: this year, we have spent INR330-odd crores. And the next year also will be in the same range. So this is the broader guidance on the capex.

items.statement: Paddy prices rose 25-30% from season opening levels; domestic prices up 20-25%, international spot prices up 15-20% above season rates.
items.quote: The prices have gone up very high. From the base level, if I talk about whatever was the opening price, roughly 25% to 30% prices have gone up.

items.statement: U.S. retail demand remains resilient with no consumption impact from inflation or geopolitical issues; volume grew 7-8% ex-Golden Star.
items.quote: As far as demand side is concerned, we have not seen any impact. And historically also because being the food and U.S., whatever the income is, that's the last thing to get impacted.

items.statement: Premium SKUs in India grew 2x vs overall consumer bag business, driving mix improvement and gross margin expansion.
items.quote: Our most premium SKU saw a 2x growth compared to the whole consumer bag business. So from that perspective, we are working on improving our product mix, which drives better gross margins.

items.statement: FY26 capex ~INR350 crores, majorly for U.S. Houston land purchase, RTH facility, and warehouse; U.K. packaging facility and India land/warehousing also contributed.
items.quote: The capex spent in the last year is almost INR350 crores. And in that, the major capex that has spent is basically in the lines of the U.S. We have purchased the land and we have invested in the RTH facility, so in the U.S.

items.statement: RTH/RTC capacity constraints limited growth; enhanced capacities expected operational from Q2 FY27 to unlock demand.
items.quote: The enhanced capacities are expected to become operational from Q2 FY'27.

items.statement: Middle East freight costs surged 10-15x (Dubai $200 to $2,200; Jeddah $700-800 to $2,600) with delivery disruptions, though region is small for LT Foods.
items.quote: Like Dubai was $200, now $2,200. Jeddah was $700, $800, now $2,600. So it depends. And there is a big disruption in the delivery also in the Middle East.

items.statement: India distribution reach flat at 172,000 outlets; household reach rose to 64.4 lakh (up 22.8% in 15 months); India market share 23.7% per Nielsen.
items.quote: India distribution is flat at 172,000. So flattish, hasn't grown much in the last quarter, but we've seen an improvement in our market share compared to last year same quarter.

items.statement: RTH/RTC segment targets INR300 crores (U.S.) and INR120 crores (India) by 2030; segment breakeven at INR400 crores revenue expected in 2 years.
items.quote: achieving a INR400 crores in the segment will make us breakeven in this segment. So that's our target.

items.statement: Organic segment under stress due to currency fluctuations and commodity price pressure; strategically remodeled for next growth phase with CPG entry.
items.quote: Further, the EBITDA is also currently under stress due to currency fluctuations and commodity price pressure.

items.statement: Supply constraints on smartphones, PCs, GPUs expected to last 12-18 months
items.quote: In 2 to 3 quarters, I mean, the supply issue is probably going to last for 12 to 18 months from what we hear.

items.statement: Targets 10-12% EBITDA margin for FY27, up from 9.3% reported in FY26
items.quote: So I mean -- so our trajectory is definitely 10% to 12%. So 10% is our first big milestone from the company perspective, given that the expansion which has been taking place. So yes, I mean, we are looking at a range of 10% to 12% in the coming years, starting with FY '27.

items.statement: Bangladesh capex of INR 250 crore to complete by H1 FY27, adding 6-7 million pieces capacity
items.quote: A capex of INR250 crores has already been committed and is expected to be completed by H1 FY '27. This timeline is in line with what was declared at the beginning of the financial year.

items.statement: Plans INR 200-250 crore capex for FY27 across geographies; Board approved Indonesia stake buy and Vietnam land purchase
items.quote: We continue to build capacity and capability across groups, and we are in the process of outlining capex commitment of INR200 crores to INR250 crores for FY '27 across geographies.

items.statement: Seeing good traction in India order books post tariff removal and EU/UK FTA interest
items.quote: So yes, with this tariff moving away from India, definitely, we are seeing a positive response from the customers. And also added to that are the other European Union and U.K. customers' interest because of the potential FTA implementation in the next few quarters or a year.

items.statement: Guatemala operations reworked; expects breakeven in FY27
items.quote: Guatemala operations, we have reworked on the strategy of operations in Guatemala. And given that strategy, as we are in the first quarter of FY '27, I see that it is working out, and we should be able to have breakeven in FY '27.

items.statement: Realization per garment at INR 635-640; targets sustaining INR 600+
items.quote: We are already at INR635, INR640 per garment. And I think it should continue it should sustain.

items.statement: FY26 standalone EBITDA margin improved 90 bps to 13.1%; Q4 margin up 30 bps to 12.6%
items.quote: EBITDA margin at 13.1% for FY '26 versus 12.2% for FY '25. So there's a growth of 90 basis points in EBITDA margin.

items.statement: Some material cost inflation will be passed on to market; regular price increases taken
items.quote: I think some of the material cost inflation is such that it's going to be hard for players to absorb all of it themselves. So, some of it will certainly get passed on to the market.

items.statement: High horsepower segment approaching double-digit market share; sold units up to 3,000 kVA and 6.3 MW for nuclear
items.quote: In our high horsepower segment, where our market share was negligible a couple of years ago, we are now approaching double digits.

items.statement: Geopolitical situation may cause short-to-medium term structural changes; monitoring macro environment closely
items.quote: As far as the current geopolitical situation is concerned, we may see short to medium-term structural changes play out. I think we are keenly watching out for the macro environment.

items.statement: New subsidiary Kirloskar Advanced Systems formed for defense and systems integration opportunities
items.quote: We have incorporated a new subsidiary called Kirloskar Advanced Systems Private Limited. We believe there's significant potential in advanced technology, particularly to serve key accounts in sectors like defense.

items.statement: Netherlands subsidiary incorporated for efficient international structuring and energy transition technologies
items.quote: Given international is a very big component of our five-year goal, it's just important for us to structure ourselves efficiently as we're growing to create value for our stakeholders.

items.statement: Management reiterated 15% AUM growth guidance for FY27, to be reviewed after Q1/Q2
items.quote: Always in the first quarter, we have always been giving a guidance of 15% only. So, as usual, last 10 years, we have been giving 15% guidance in the first quarter.

items.statement: Plans to open 200-300 branches at Muthoot Finance and ~200 gold loan branches at Belstar Microfinance in FY27
items.quote: Okay, so probably last year, we opened 170 branches or so. This year, maybe 200-300 branches. That's it.

items.statement: Raised interest rates by 0.5-1% on certain loan types last quarter, contributing to yield increase
items.quote: Last quarter, we increased our rates by about 0.5% to 1% over certain types of loans. So, that is why we see the yield has gone up.

items.statement: Reported yield of 20.76% includes one-off auction income (INR 50 cr) and ARC income (INR 35 cr); sustainable yield lower
items.quote: So, there was an auction income of about 50 crores. ARC, I think it is around INR 35 crores. So, totally INR 85 crores. And there was some increase in the pricing also in the last quarter.

items.statement: Stage 3 NPA rose to 2.34% due to RBI-mandated borrower-wise classification; LTV on NPA book only 58%, fully recoverable
items.quote: So, the stage 3 increase has happened primarily because RBI has advised us to do a borrower wise classification. So, earlier we were doing this classification at the loan level.

items.statement: Unsecured personal loan book ~INR 4,000 cr, mainly cross-sell to existing gold loan customers
items.quote: These are unsecured personal loans, salaried personal loan and unsecured personal loans, which is doing actually quite well. We have about INR 4,000 crores of portfolios, mostly cross-sell.

items.statement: Muthoot Money gold loan AUM grew 151% to INR 9,794 cr; received INR 1,000 cr capital infusion; credit rating upgraded to AA+
items.quote: Muthoot Money, which is doing vehicle finance, has been running down its vehicle finance business and has gone into the gold loan business. And gold loan, the AUM stands at INR 9,794 crores versus INR 3,900 crores last year, a growth of 151%.

items.statement: Belstar Microfinance collection efficiency improved to 99.85%; opened 81 gold loan branches to diversify
items.quote: The collection efficiency in the microfinance increased by 0.69% and now stands at 99.85%, which was 99.16% last year.

items.statement: Declared highest ever dividend of 300% (INR 30/share); 14th consecutive year since IPO
items.quote: Muthoot Finance declared the highest dividend of 300% or INR 30 per share and this is the 14th year of consistent dividend declaration since our IPO in 2011.

items.statement: Assessments order book for FY27 is 80-85% of FY26 full-year revenue, indicating healthy revenue growth ahead
items.quote: As we speak, the order book for FY27 for the Assessments business is almost close to 80 to 85% of the entire revenue we achieved in the full year of FY26.

items.statement: EdTech profitability to improve from Q1 FY27 despite flat revenues, due to cost structure recalibration
items.quote: While revenues may stay flat for another four quarters before they begin to see an uptick, on the profitability side, we will definitely see the needle beginning to show a positive upward movement from Q1 itself.

items.statement: MarTech targeting steady revenue growth with enhanced margins over next 12-24 months via mix shift to CEP, VOSMOS, VIRSA
items.quote: With enhanced focus over the next 12 to 24 months, this business should continue to grow at a steady, stable revenue growth rate with enhanced margins.

items.statement: Assessments EBITDA grew 50% YoY to ₹51 crore on 9% revenue growth, showing operating leverage
items.quote: The assessment business revenue grew from ₹ 205 crores to ₹ 223 crores, generating an operating EBITDA of about ₹ 51 crore versus ₹ 34 crores last year.

items.statement: EdTech average realization down 12-14% YoY due to shift to modular products at ₹2,000-4,000 vs full programs at ₹30,000-60,000
items.quote: The average realization saw a dramatic downward movement of about 12 to 14%, which resulted in our overall revenue declining by about 11% from the previous year.

items.statement: Higher education enrollments expected to grow from 4.5 crore to 8 crore in 5-6 years, 60% via online programs from top 200 universities
items.quote: The expected growth of higher education enrollments in colleges and universities is expected to grow from 4.5 crores to 8 crores. And about 60% of them are expected to come through online university programs offered by the top 200 universities.

items.statement: CL-DEXIT empaneled with top 200 NIRF universities for enrollment, job readiness, career training and placement
items.quote: Among these top 200 universities, we will now begin our work to help them in enrollment, job readiness and career training, and also placement.

items.statement: RPS capital reduction of ~₹193-194 crore (including interest) pending NCLT approval; order reserved, next hearing tomorrow
items.quote: The cash that was left behind was approximately ₹ 182 crores, and it has generated interest during the time it has been with us — for almost a year — to the tune of about ₹ 11 to 12 crores. So as on date, there are approximately ₹ 193 to 194 crores of the cash that you see on our balance sheet which belongs to NSE.

items.statement: Expects double-digit or high single-digit billing growth, double-digit revenue growth, and PAT more than doubling in Q1 FY27 vs Q1 FY26
items.quote: We are highly confident in delivering robust financial performance, anticipating either double -digit billing growth or high single-digit growth in billing, double-digit revenue growth and more than doubling of profit compared to Q1 of last year.

items.statement: Expects double-digit or high single-digit billing growth for full FY27
items.quote: We expect double digit billing growth also possibly this year as well. So, the high single digit growth or double -digit growth for the FY’27 as well.

items.statement: Matchmaking EBITDA margin improved to 22% in Q4 FY26 from 19.2% in Q3 FY26 and 17.7% in Q4 FY25
items.quote: Our EBITDA margin for the Matchmaking business in Q4 is at 22% as compared to 19.2% in Q3 and 17.7% a year ago.

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin improved to 12.4% in Q4 FY26 from 11.3% in Q3 FY26 and 10.8% in Q4 FY25
items.quote: On a consolidated basis, our EBITDA margins in Q4 are at 12.4% as compared to 11.3% in Q3 and 10.8% a year ago.

items.statement: Matchmaking average transaction value increased 15.3% YoY and 3.6% QoQ in Q4 FY26
items.quote: Average transaction value for the Matchmaking business increased by 15.3% year-on-year and 3.6% over previous quarter.

items.statement: Tier-2 and Tier-3 markets combined are larger than Tier-1 market
items.quote: Tier-2, Tier-3 combinied is bigger than Tier-1 market.

items.statement: Opened first Elite Matrimony Center in Hyderabad in Q4 FY26
items.quote: Considering the immense potential to grow our Personal Service segment, we opened our first ever Elite Matrimony Center in Hyderabad in Q4 of FY26.

items.statement: Wedding Services segment losses widening; breakeven not expected in near future, focus on product-market fit
items.quote: In terms of when it will breakeven, definitely it's a long way to go. But it's more of getting the product market fit and getting the opportunity right, then it's more of scaling up.

items.statement: Marketing expenses expected to remain at similar levels (around INR 180 cr annually) unless strong need to change
items.quote: The marketing expenses at this point of time is expected to be at the similar level until otherwise if there is any strong need to increase or decrease. So, we tend to operate at a similar level.

items.statement: ManyJobs monetization started in Tamil Nadu with 1M+ users and 10K+ companies; may expand to South or pan-India by year-end upon revenue milestones
items.quote: Currently, we are starting only in Tamil Nadu, we already got more than 1 million users registered to ManyJobs platform and more than 10,000 companies are using it. We started monetizing. So, again, still in the early stages. So, the end of the year, once we reach our revenue milestone, then we may expand to South or e

items.statement: Completed share buyback of INR 58.5 cr in Q4 FY26; will continue evaluating shareholder reward opportunities
items.quote: We completed a share buyback in Q4 of FY26, amounting to INR 58.5 crores to reward our shareholders. We will continue to evaluate opportunities to reward our shareholders in the future as well, subject to necessary Board and Shareholders’ approval.

items.statement: Invested in AI-based astrology startup 'Bharat Ek Khoj'; early stage, monitoring progress
items.quote: In terms of investment on the’ Bharat Ek Khoj’, it's an investment into one of the AI -based astrology company. It's a recent investment. It's one of the startup. So, we see an opportunity. And so it's a startup and we will continue to monitor.

items.statement: Luv.com (serious matchmaking) launched, early stages with good traction in metros
items.quote: We also got into serious matchmaking . We launched Luv.com. And again, still in the early stages, but having a good traction. So, Luv.com is a serious matchmaking service from Matrimony.com group.

items.statement: Standalone revenue growth guided at 10-15% with EBITDA margins of 10-15% for FY27
items.quote: For the standalone business, we expect revenue growth of 10% to 15% with EBITDA margins in the same 10% to 15% range.

items.statement: Innoxel revenue growth guided at 35-45% with EBITDA margins of 20-25% for FY27
items.quote: For Innoxel, we expect revenue growth of 35% to 45% with EBITDA margins of 20% to 25%.

items.statement: Varenyam Healthcare revenue growth guided at 20-25% with EBITDA margins of 8-13% for FY27
items.quote: For Varenyam Healthcare, we expect revenue growth of about 20% to 25% with EBITDA margins of 8% to 13%.

items.statement: Standalone order book stands at INR 171 crores providing visibility for FY27
items.quote: The order book today stands at INR 171 crores, which gives us reasonable visibility for FY '27.

items.statement: Varenyam Biolifesciences facility approved budget INR 160 crores, CWIP INR 33 crores, 20% complete
items.quote: Our approved budget is around INR 160 crores and our CWIP at the year-end was around INR 33 crores. So we're about 20% of the way through in terms of cost.

items.statement: Standalone capacity utilization at 48% General, 21% beta-lactam, 24% cephalosporins with headroom for 10-15% growth without fresh capex
items.quote: We are at 48% on the General, 21% on beta-lactam, and 24% on cephalosporins. There is meaningful headroom here and we don't need fresh capex to grow the standalone business by 10% to 15% next year.

items.statement: Varenyam Healthcare to expand field force to 250+ and launch 7 new products including Remishot and second gynecology division in FY27
items.quote: We expect the field force to expand upwards of 250 people, seven new product launches including Remishot, which will be India's first made-in-India and the launch of our second division, which will operate in gynecology.

items.statement: Innoxel FY27 EBITDA margins 20-25% driven primarily by milestone payments, commercial CMO supply starting Q2 FY27
items.quote: This would be for FY '27 on the margin front at Innoxel primarily it would be due to milestone payments because though the commercial supplies will start it is -- it would still be for maybe two or at max three products and not more.

items.statement: Standalone growth impacted by PIC/S and EUGMP inspections in FY27 causing production disruptions, full recovery expected by FY28
items.quote: We still expect a little bit of disruption due to two major audit events which would be at the standalone facilities which is, like I said, PIC/S and EU GMP. So there would be certain disruptions due to, owing to those.

items.statement: Varenyam Biolifesciences commercial supply delayed to Q4 FY29 due to geopolitical disturbances causing 3-month delay
items.quote: The current geopolitical disturbance has had an impact on the, I wouldn't say too much of an impact, but we are 3 months, at least one quarter running behind on schedule as to what we had expected earlier.

items.statement: Innoxel targets 10 new filings, 20 new partner deals (10 advanced), first MHRA and Health Canada filings, out-licensing income INR 70-90 crores in FY27
