items.quote: I think I've maintained an EBITDA margin of 26% to 27% because given expansions, new products, raw material fluctuations, I think that's a reasonably achievable EBITDA margin on a long-term basis.

items.statement: Expects double-digit growth for IB and HP-MTBE in FY27.
items.quote: IB and HP -MTBE reported a stable performance during the year, and we expect both products to achieve double -digit growth in FY 2027.

items.statement: Anticipates moderate growth in butyl phenols in FY27.
items.quote: Our butyl phenols segment delivered steady performance in FY 2026, and we anticipate moderate growth in FY 2027, supported by improving demand conditions.

items.statement: Antioxidants segment to maintain strong momentum in FY27.
items.quote: We expect this segment to maintain strong momentum in FY 2027, supported by market expansion and ongoing product development.

items.statement: Plans INR250-300 crores annual investment for next 3-5 years.
items.quote: We do feel every year we should be investing around INR250 crores or INR300 crores for the next 3 to 5 years, and that's the growth trajectory that we are looking at.

items.statement: New products in fragrance, personal care, food additives, plastics; revenues from FY28.
items.quote: They will be catering to segments such as the fragrance industry, such as personal care, antioxidants in the food additives business. But most of them, I think what's important, they are niche chemicals.

items.statement: ATBS and IBB pricing stable with formula-based mechanism.
items.quote: It remains stable. We follow our formula-based pricing mechanism, and that's where it is at.

items.statement: Antidumping duty on antioxidants rejected; reapplied, decision in 6-9 months.
items.quote: So first of all, we did not hear back for the ADD on antioxidants, which means it was rejected. We have reapplied again for it because we have a strong case.

items.statement: ATBS capacity utilization at 75-80% after expansion.
items.quote: See, ATBS, presently, we are running at, I would say, about 80% capacity utilization, 75% even after the expansion.

items.statement: Antioxidants and butyl phenol revenue target INR800-900 crores in 2 years.
items.quote: It's on track, both AO and butyl phenol means in the range of INR800 crores to INR900 crores. We will see that in the next 2 years.

items.statement: Expects high single-digit consolidated top line growth for FY27.
items.quote: On the guidance, we expect high single -digit consolidated top line growth for FY27 based on our current understanding of the regulatory and macro environment.

items.statement: Expects FY27 R&D spend at 6-7% of sales.
items.quote: We expect our FY27 R&D spend to be 6% to 7% of the sales for the next year.

items.statement: Organon acquisition expected to complete in Q4 FY27.
items.quote: We expect the acquisition to be completed in Q4 FY27.

items.statement: Effective tax rate expected around 25% for next year and beyond.
items.quote: Yes. We expect the effective tax rate to be in the range of 25%.

items.statement: No sales from LEQSELVI/UNLOXCYT outside US factored this year.
items.quote: I think we are not factoring any sales out of this product in any geographies other than the US this year.

items.statement: Higher Q4 spend to normalize in subsequent quarters.
items.quote: Some of these spends were elevated for the quarter, and we should see it normalizing in the subsequent quarters.

items.statement: ILUMYA launched in 40 countries, up from 35.
items.quote: So, if you remember a couple of quarters back, I said like ILUMYA, we launched in 35 countries. Now it has gone to 40 countries, and it is helping us to grow.

items.statement: Oral semaglutide clinical study completed; will launch upon approval.
items.quote: Sure. So for oral, we have completed the clinical study. And once we get approval, we will launch the product at the earliest.

items.statement: LEQSELVI Phase III trial in adolescents underway.
items.quote: Yes. We do have an active Phase III trial underway for LEQSELVI in adolescents, you're correct.

items.statement: New sterile facility in Madhya Pradesh for global supply.
items.quote: Yes. This is a sterile-only facility.

items.statement: Innovative R&D spend expected to increase as pipeline grows.
items.quote: But as more and more products get into our development pipeline, the innovative R&D spend will go up.

items.statement: US specialty growth expected from ILUMYA, LEQSELVI, UNLOXCYT.
items.quote: And certainly, if we look at this current fiscal yea r and the one we're coming into, we expect to see continued growth from ILUMYA.

items.statement: Majority access for LEQSELVI in US as of April 1.
items.quote: So as of April 1, we have a majority of access now in the US market.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 expected to reflect Q4 FY26 trends; corporate gifting muted and export demand affected.
items.quote: Quarter 1 FY 2027 is expected to reflect the trends seen in quarter 4 FY '26.

items.statement: No formal FY27 guidance; will wait another quarter for better visibility.
items.quote: Given the current uncertainties, we believe it will be prudent to await another quarter to gain better visibility before providing formal guidance on our outlook for the year FY27.

items.statement: West Bengal manufacturing facility expected operational by Q3 FY27.
items.quote: Subsidiary with Morris, progress remains linked to our upcoming West Bengal manufacturing facility, which is expected to become operational by quarter 3 FY27.

items.statement: Board approved additional $250,000 investment in Turkish JV with matching partner contribution.
items.quote: Linc's Board has approved a further investment of $250,000 with a matching contribution from the JV partner maintaining the existing shareholding structure.

items.statement: Polymer prices rose due to supply disruptions; full pass-through not immediately feasible.
items.quote: Polymer prices, our principal raw materials, have also risen due to supply-side disruptions. And given competitive dynamics, immediate full pass-through in pricing may not be feasible.

items.statement: April GT channel showed double-digit growth; expects distribution improvement in coming quarters.
items.quote: And if we look at GT channel growth, so if we look at our April performance, our April performance in GT channel has shown a double-digit growth, actually.

items.statement: Sales team split into mass and premium verticals; added 125 frontline sales staff from April 2026.
items.quote: So this has been one initiative, and we have actually added about 125 frontline sales team to our team -- sales team strength.

items.statement: New Pentonic products at INR20+ planned for this year and next financial year.
items.period: this year and next financial year
items.quote: We have a couple of new developments in INR20 and above in the Pentonic portfolio. Probably 1 or 2 even in the -- yes, probably 2 or 3 of them, we have planned for this year and a couple of more for next financial year.

items.statement: Export demand affected by Middle East war; Q4 exports degrew 25% YoY, some containers unshipped.
items.quote: If we look at -- so quarter 4 was almost 25% degrowth year-on-year. A lot of our exports to the Middle East and Eastern Africa was affected because of this situation.

items.statement: Geopolitical disruptions outweigh currency depreciation benefits; raw material imports also impacted.
items.quote: But the overall geopolitical situations had far outweighed the benefits of the rupee depreciation.

items.statement: Net cash position of INR686 lakhs as of March 31, 2026.
items.quote: Our balance sheet remained strong throughout the year with a net cash position of INR686 lakhs as on 31st March 2026, reflecting continued financial discipline.

items.statement: Kenya subsidiary sales momentum improving; expects positive trajectory to strengthen.
items.quote: Kenya subsidiary, sales momentum has started to improve, and we expect this positive trajectory to strengthen further in the coming periods.

items.statement: Linc-on subsidiary operations commenced; expected to gain meaningful traction this financial year.
items.quote: Linc-on subsidiary. Operations have commenced and the business is expected to gain meaningful traction from this financial year.

items.statement: Consolidated revenue guidance for FY27.
items.quote: On a consol basis, we are guiding a revenue of INR2,300 crores to INR2,400 crores, up from INR1,875 crores we have done in FY '26, which will include full year consolidation of PendraCare and Citieffe.

items.statement: Standalone revenue guidance for FY27.
items.quote: On stand-alone basis, we are guiding on a revenue of INR1,900 crores to INR1950 crores with domestic business growing upwards of 20% and international business growing upwards of 15%.

items.statement: Standalone EBITDA margin guidance for FY27.
items.quote: Stand-alone EBITDA margin is expected to be -- again, we are giving a guidance of 25% to 27% range.

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin guidance for FY27.
items.quote: On a consolidated basis, EBITDA margin -- because our subsidiaries operate at lower EBITDA margin right now and we are in the phase of doing a lot of cost-saving projects there, so we expect this year consolidated EBITDA to be between 23% and 25%, but stand-alone will be between 25% and 27%.

items.statement: Capex guidance for FY27.
items.quote: We expect to spend between INR200 crores to INR225 crores on capex this year.

items.statement: Gross margin may erode by 200-300 bps due to raw material inflation.
items.quote: So on the current situation based on where we are today as on today, we may see some erosion on gross margin going from, let's say, 68% to maybe around 66% or maybe in that region, maybe lower by 200 bps, 300 bps.

items.statement: Price increases of 3-5% obtained from customers to offset cost inflation.
items.quote: But let me tell you that the freight cost and minimum wage revision in Haryana has caused some disruption, but we are able to get our price increase from customers between range of 3% to 5% already.

items.statement: Renal segment expected to grow over 20% in FY27 despite Chinese competition.
items.quote: But in spite of all that, maybe it happens, doesn't happen, I think we are still targeting a growth of over 20% in Renal.

items.statement: Infusion Therapy share of revenue declined to 50% in Q4 FY26 from 57% a year ago.
items.quote: Infusion Therapy now accounts for 50% of the revenue, down from 57% in Q4 '25 with Renal around 11%, steadily rising, share coming from Cardiology, Critical Care and other acquisitions.

items.statement: Raw material costs up ~20% due to crude-linked inflation, impacting gross margin.
items.quote: And we see there was an impact of around 20% on an aggregate basis in raw materials and a meaningful headwind to the gross margin.

items.statement: Acquired Medyneo in Brazil for ~$40,000 to fast-track market entry.
items.quote: From an acquisition standpoint, it was about $40,000.

items.statement: Citieffe and PendraCare expected to improve EBITDA margins to 18-20% in 2-3 years.
items.quote: But I think in next 2, 3 years, we could see that improvement to going to around 18% to 20%.

items.statement: Receivable cycle expected to remain similar in FY27 due to international environment.
items.quote: I think at the moment, looking at the environment, I would expect receivable cycle to be similar for FY '27.

items.statement: Target revenue mix of 1/3 India and 2/3 rest of world.
items.quote: So ideally, I would like it to be between like 1/3 India and 2/3 RoW.

items.statement: FY27 revenue expected around INR800 crores, with motion pictures contributing about 50%.
items.quote: So FY27, if I say we will be expecting close to around, say, INR800-odd crores top line, largely driven by motion pictures. Movie will give almost 50% of it.

items.statement: Commissioned shows (TV+OTT) expected to grow to INR330 crores in FY27 from INR160 crores in FY26.
items.quote: if my commissioned shows, which is TV plus OTT, which is B2B business, which was around INR160-odd crores in the FY26, we expect it to be around INR330 crores in the coming fiscal year.

items.statement: Motion pictures expected to deliver close to INR400 crores top line in FY27 versus INR15 crores last year.
items.quote: And we expect this year close to INR400 crores top line coming from Motion Pictures itself as compared to only INR15 crores, which was there last year.

items.statement: OTT order book approximately INR350 crores, with over INR135 crores expected to be realized in FY27.
items.quote: We now have an order book of approximately INR350 crores under this line, out of which we expect to realize over INR135 crores or so within the ongoing financial year FY27.

items.statement: Order book of over INR350 crores, with around INR50 crores added each quarter.
items.quote: We have an order book of over INR350 crores plus around INR50 crores gets added each quarter.

items.statement: Investment in motion pictures expected to be INR125-150 crores at any given point.
items.quote: And typically, we will have investment of around INR125 crores to INR150 crores at any given point of time because certain movies will be on floor, certain movies will be nearing release and certain movies will be in advanced stage of discussion and rolling out for the next schedule.

items.statement: Digital business requires working capital of INR10-15 crores.
items.quote: And digital business, not more than INR10 crores to INR15 crores, we require working capital to run that stream.

items.statement: OTT margins will not be as robust as television due to finite series nature.
items.quote: So though -- even the top line increases manyfold, I believe the margin will not be as robust as television.

items.statement: TV content yield is down 25-30% compared to pre-COVID levels, impacting production house margins.
items.quote: In fact, if we just compare the yield to the pre -COVID year rate, we are still down by 25% to 30%.

items.statement: TV show tenure has reduced to 6-9 months, affecting production house returns.
items.quote: With the tenure of the shows, very few shows run more than a year these days. If you just scan the -- each of these broadcast companies, you will find 6 to 9 months is becoming the norm.

items.statement: In 2-3 years, motion pictures to contribute over 50% of top line, digital next, TV least.
items.quote: I believe in next 2 to 3 years, this pyramid will shift and Balaji will be more an IP -led content creator with the movie contributing more than 50% to the top line and profitability, followed by digital business. And television will be the least contributor to the segment.

items.statement: TV business yield declining and broadcasters not investing enough in content.
items.quote: So there is a -- the investment into the content from the broadcast side has significantly slowed down and considerably reduced. As a result, all the production houses will see their margin getting depleted.

items.statement: Company has INR165 crores liquid cash and expects no direct tax for next 4-5 years due to brought forward losses.
items.quote: With a healthy liquidity position, we have over INR165 crores liquid cash into the banks and mutual funds and a robust pipeline across television, films and digital platforms, we remain confident about the medium- to long-term growth opportunity for the business.

items.statement: Digital business expected to be cash positive in FY27, with cash burn reduced to INR50 lakhs per month.
items.quote: The turnaround is expected in FY27 with overall digital business will be cash positive.

items.statement: Management expects double-digit revenue growth, consistent with historical performance.
items.quote: we would say that as historically that we always look for a double-digit growth in our revenues, and that's what we would also say today.

items.statement: Margins expected to remain stable, but difficult to project due to current situation.
items.quote: I mean with the change in scenarios, I would say it's difficult to project, but we would say it would remain stable.

items.statement: Capex for next year expected to be constant unless major new projects arise.
items.quote: I would say the capex for the following year, unless we see any major custom synthesis project or any new project that's in our way, it would be a constant capex.

items.statement: Capital work in progress stands at ₹2,113 crores as of March 31, 2026.
items.quote: Capital work in progress as of March 31, 2026 stood at ₹2,113 crores.

items.statement: Assets worth ₹1,544 crores capitalized during the year, with ₹800 crores in Q4.
items.quote: During the year, the company capitalized assets worth ₹ 1,544 crores, out of which approximately ₹800 crores is capitalized in the last quarter.

items.statement: Freight-related cost pressures expected to continue in the near term.
items.quote: Freight-related cost pressures are expected to continue in the near term, and we have incorporated these factors into our planning for the coming quarters.

items.statement: Raw material price increases are being passed on to customers where feasible.
items.quote: We are seeing price increases. But we are factoring them in, and we are trying to pass on wherever feasible.

items.statement: Generic APIs backed by long-term contracts with variability clauses protect against raw material price hikes.
items.quote: most of our APIs on the generic segment are backed by long-term contracts, which have variability clauses, which protects us from such situations.

items.statement: Steady volume growth in generics from existing portfolio; new products to add later.
items.quote: Yes, the volume has been picked up. We had steady growth in volume, and our customer base has been quite steady in the generic business.

items.statement: Product mix for FY26: generics 45%, custom synthesis 55%.
items.quote: The product mix between generics and custom synthesis for the year was at 45% and 55%, respectively.

items.statement: Supply chain difficulties but no production stoppages; securing materials quarterly.
items.quote: we are having difficulty in sourcing material, but we are not having any production stoppages at our end.

items.statement: Peptide facility aims to be among largest globally with multiple 3,000-liter SPPS.
items.quote: We have several 3,000-liter SPPS, which by far in India nobody has. We are quite strong and committed towards this segment, and we are targeting to be one of the largest global players in the world.

items.statement: Three dedicated CS projects in validation/supply; commercialization expected around 2027 subject to customer approvals.
items.quote: We are hopeful by 2027 it will be commercialized or earlier or maybe later. Everything is subjected to regulatory approvals for our customer

items.statement: Sustainable realization per kg is INR165, not the Q4 level of INR178.
items.quote: I think a sustainable figure is INR165 and thereabouts as Kunal explained.

items.statement: Operating margin may decline to 24-26% as grinding media volume mix increases.
items.quote: Then the operating margins in absolute numbers will grow, but as a percentage can come down in the range of 26%-24%.

items.statement: India maintenance capex and renewable investment outflow expected INR100-150 crores.
items.quote: So total, we don't expect more than between INR100 crores and INR150 crores of outflow on accounts of maintenance capex and the renewable balancing investment left for the renewable part.

items.statement: Renewable project requires INR30 crores balancing capex to complete.
items.quote: After which I think we're going to spend about INR30 crores that's balance on that.

items.statement: New discharge system solution win at large South American mine; second mine order received.
items.quote: So after the successful trial in one of their mines, they have immediately also given us the order for the second mine conversion.

items.statement: Addressable market for gold and copper mines is 800,000 to 1 million tons.
items.quote: I think there is a large market. 800,000 to 1 million ton market for gold and copper and all mines facing critical issues.

items.statement: Shipping cost pass-through is 100%; no margin impact from shipping volatility.
items.quote: And anyway, we work with 100% passthrough.

items.statement: Global shipping uncertainty and protectionist measures are key risks.
items.quote: There is extreme uncertainty as far as global shipping is concerned.

items.statement: Tax rate for FY27 expected at 22% effective.
items.quote: You consider it as 22% effectively.

items.statement: Capacity utilization at 55%, can go up to 70-75% without new capex.
items.quote: Current capacity utilization this year is about 55% overall.

items.statement: Brazil volumes expected at 6,000-8,000 tons but scale-up slower than hoped.
items.quote: We should be doing 6,000, 8,000 tons in Brazil, but it still needs to scale up.

items.statement: No specific volume guidance for FY27; conversion timeline uncertain.
items.quote: We are not giving any specific numbers about metallic or composite.

items.statement: Cash balance high at INR4,300 crores; plans to deploy in 6-12 months.
items.quote: With that said, total cash -- net cash is about INR4,300 crores.

items.statement: Renewable power to cover 60-65% of consumption, saving INR1.5 per unit.
items.quote: So, which means I'll become almost 60%-65% dependent on my own captive renewable power.

items.statement: No FY27-28 guidance due to geopolitical uncertainty; will provide after Q1.
items.quote: However, after the first quarter, we'll be in a better position to give you a guidance, what we will be doing in '27-'28.

items.statement: Five revenue-share hotels require INR5-10 crore capex each, funded internally.
items.quote: Those do not require more than INR 5 crores to INR10 crores as a CapEx, which company has the money.

items.statement: Signed pipeline of 52 hotels with 3,600 rooms; ~500 keys on revenue share.
items.quote: there are 52 hotels which are signed and comprising of 3,600 rooms

items.statement: For every 10 hotels signed: ~7 management, 2 franchise, 1 flexi-lease.
items.quote: for every 10 hotels we sign, one would probably be a flexi lease, maybe two would be a franchise, seven would be management.

items.statement: Fee-based management income expected to be one-third to half of future EBITDA.
items.quote: I would say it would probably be a third of our total, but it does depend on how many flexi leases we sign.

items.statement: Post-war business hit; ADRs and occupancies under pressure, cost inflation rising.
items.quote: However, last one month post -war, definitely the business has got hit. The ADRs is in challenge, the occupancies are in challenge, and it continues to grow, you know, it continues to be the challenge like that.

items.statement: New labour code and fuel prices adding cost pressure; cannot fully pass on to customers.
items.quote: This new labour code and the fuel prices have added to this thing and the labour code expenses are very, very high.

items.statement: ICONIQA Mumbai Q4 occupancy 62%; Jan 80%, Feb 73%; current quarter 81%.
items.quote: So the occupancy of ICONIQA was 62% in Q4.

items.statement: ADR grew from INR5,800 to INR6,000+; occupancy flat due to war impact.
items.quote: So from 5,800, we have grown to 6,000 and odd. However, the occupancy remained the same for last year.

items.statement: ICONIQA PAT to remain negative in FY27 due to Ind AS; profitable by FY28.
items.quote: Probably this year also PAT will be negative and maybe in '27-'28, we will move to a profitable position.

items.statement: Hampton by Hilton partnership: 125 hotels over 10 years, ~75 keys average.
items.quote: that's a long-term 10-year partnership for the Hampton by Hilton brand in 6 states in India where we are going to be opening about 125 hotels with them.

items.statement: Vision 2030: 345 hotels, 22,000 keys, asset-light, AI integration, loyalty ecosystem.
items.quote: By 2030, we aim to reach 345 hotels, grow to 22,000 keys, strengthen our asset light business model, deeply integrate AI and technology into operations and build stronger connected loyalty ecosystem through Regenta Rewards.

items.statement: Regenta Hotels subsidiary FY26 top line INR55-56 crore, EBITDA INR20 crore.
items.quote: So, there we have done a top line of almost INR55 crores -- INR56 crores.

items.statement: Board recommended final dividend of INR2.5 per equity share.
items.quote: the Board has recommended a final dividend of INR2.5 per equity share.

items.statement: Management targets EBITDA margin of 19% to 21% for the coming year.
items.quote: We're still confident that we will operate between 19% to 21%. This year, '25-'26, has been a year of very good performance in terms of margin. We closed the year with 22%. But our range, we believe, will be between 19% and 21%, and that's what we'll be targeting for the coming year as well.

items.statement: Management plans to take price increases in Q1 FY27 to cover input cost inflation.
items.quote: But in quarter 1, we are expecting to again touch our prices given how the input costs are trending.

items.statement: A 2% weighted average price increase was taken in January for product enhancements, not inflation.
items.quote: And that is to the tune of about 2% weighted average. But in terms of how much has flown into revenues, it will be quite minimal because, let's say, about 2 to 3 weeks at best within the quarter where we would have realized the revised prices.

items.statement: Management plans to invest in technology and digital transformation, adding to costs.
items.quote: So I think if you look at it, today's guidance is largely given a year or 2's outlook, and that's why we're looking at a 19% to 21% because there are going to be investments in technology, which is unprecedented as far as Page is concerned in the previous years. So that's going to add to costs.

items.statement: Management expects to realize INR40-50 crores of subsidy in FY27 from Odisha.
items.quote: But yes, in FY27, we have plans to start realizing the subsidies. So over the year, I think we are expecting we should be getting around INR40 crores to INR50 crores of subsidy and that will happen.

items.statement: Management expects margin pressure due to normal marketing spend and inflation, but within 19-21% range.
items.quote: So going forward, if we have a normal level of marketing spend, which is at 5% and we do see some inflationary pressure coming into the product cost, there will be some pressure on the EBITDA margin for sure. It's not expected to be as elevated as 22% last year but still be within the range of 19% to 21%.

items.statement: Management plans to increase marketing spend to close to 5% of sales in FY27.
items.quote: For the bygone year, it's about a little over 4%. We target to take that up to close to 5% in the next year.

items.statement: Management observed improved consumer sentiment and retail demand in Q4 FY26.
items.quote: During the fourth quarter, we witnessed a meaningful improvement in overall consumer sentiment and retail demand. This was reflected across all our categories and channels.

items.statement: Management is implementing a new distribution management system over the next year.
items.quote: In fact, with all of that in place now and we've kind of gone that journey, we are going to be undertaking the implementation of a new distribution management system, which is the next level of change management, which we will need to bring about within distribution.

items.statement: Management may absorb input cost inflation to protect volumes, given healthy margins.
items.quote: If it comes to a stage where we will need to touch prices to the extent that it's going to affect volumes, we would rather refrain from doing that given the healthy margins that we operate with and absorb that in the margins temporarily.

items.statement: FY27 presales guidance of INR6,000 crores from own projects, plus INR2,000 crores from DM projects, totaling INR8,000 crores.
items.value: INR6,000 crores own + INR2,000 crores DM = INR8,000 crores
items.quote: A presales of INR6,000 crores from our own projects, representing a 30% year-on-year growth, along with an additional INR2,000 crores from the DM projects totalling INR8,000crores.

items.statement: FY27 collections guidance of approximately INR3,000 crores, ~75% YoY growth.
items.quote: Collections of a pproximately INR3,000 crores, reflecting around 75% year -on-year growth driven by the milestone -linked inflows from existing launches and ongoing projects.

items.statement: FY27 new launch GDV of ~INR19,400 crores across 11 owned projects and 2 DM projects.
items.quote: New launch GDV of approximately INR19,400 crores across 11 owned projects and along 2 DM projects, Juhu and Sky Terraces in Bangalore, with the combined GDV of DM projects is approximately INR6,100 crores.

items.statement: FY27 construction spend planned at ~INR2,500 crores, using most collections.
items.quote: So , while we are expecting collections of roughly INR3,000 -odd crores this year, we also want to spend approximately INR2,500-odd crores on construction.

items.statement: Expects net surplus margin close to 50% over next several years.
items.quote: And we expect that to be close to 50% over the course of the next several years as these projects get delivered.

items.statement: Cost of debt currently 14.8%, targeting reduction to 10% over 12-18 months.
items.quote: Our expectation is to bring it to 10% over a period of time, but this will be a gradual decrease over the next 12 to 18 months.

items.statement: Plans to convert INR1,100 crores shareholder debt to equity when share price improves.
items.quote: And we have a shareholder debt today along with Blackstone, we have a shareholder debt of INR1,100 crores, which we will convert to equity over a period in time, but we're waiting for the market to correct, both the market to correct as well as our share price to correct, which will take a little more a few more months

items.statement: Promoter pledge increased to 68% due to share price fall, expected to reduce to 48% and eventually zero in 2-3 years.
items.quote: And now that the share price is moving up, this will come back to the old levels to 48%. And then what we understand from the promoters is, they plan to pay off this debt over a period of time. Maybe in the next 2 to 3 years, this pledge will keep reducing and the shares will be completely unpledged.

items.statement: Not seeing real estate slowdown yet; expects to gain market share even if market contracts.
items.quote: To be honest with you, we're not seeing that yet. There's a lot of noise about real estate slowing down, and we appreciate this is a cyclical industry. But if you just look at the Q4 launches, Verde, which sold out 80 -plus percent; Embassy Eden, which in B angalore is a INR20 crore s plus ticket size. The INR20 crores

items.statement: FY27 pipeline balanced between luxury, ultra-luxury, and fast-moving mid-segment as hedge.
items.quote: Also, if you look at the FY '27 pipeline, it's actually a great balance between the luxury, the ultra-luxury where we have Juhu, Sky Terraces and Embassy One. But beyond that, it's actually a very fast-moving mid-segment product which we feel is a perfect hedge to have as well going into this stage of the cycle.

items.statement: Top 3 milestones: presales, collections, and reduction in cost of debt over 12-18 months.
items.quote: So I would say the top 3 are presales collections and cost of debt and debt in general coming down over the next 12 to 18 months.

items.statement: Nashik SEZ debonding underway, expected to complete this fiscal year; plan industrial plotted development.
items.quote: The second thing that we are in the process of doing is basically doing a debonding exercise. So converting the land from SEZ to not having an SEZ status out here. We are already underway in that process. This will take several months to complete, but we expect to hopefully get that done during this fiscal year.

items.statement: No other legacy regulatory issues known that could harm company.
items.quote: Look, we don't know of anything else that's out there today that can harm the company and the stock. This did catch us a little bit by surprise. But I think we've overcome it and we're looking forward out here, but there is nothing else out there.

items.statement: FY27 revenue guidance of INR2,200-2,400 crores with EBITDA margins of 12-14%.
items.value: INR2,200 crores to INR2,400 crores; 12% to 14%

items.statement: FY27 Blends business revenue expected upwards of INR1,400 crores.

items.statement: FY27 Europe vanillin volume guidance of 1,500-1,600 tons, on track.

items.statement: Vinpai and Vitafor expected to be above breakeven EBITDA in FY27.

items.statement: Gross margin expected to be maintained in Q1 with 1% up or down.

items.quote: our average realization for the company for the vanillin has gone up from sub-$11 to more than $12.5 in quarter four, and we are quite confident it will grow obviously above

items.statement: Seeking debt for growth and liquidity; equity infusion is last resort, not on table.

items.statement: Hospital revenue growth expected at 15%+ for FY27.

items.statement: Diagnostics revenue growth expected to reach double digits in FY27.

items.statement: Gleneagles transaction under deliberation, no timeline provided.

items.quote: we expect the margins to improve further from here and which will be visible in the as we will see all along.

items.quote: Now subframe and torsion beams, the discussions have already started with the OEMs. These are a little long gestation period. So over a period of few quarters, we anticipate to see success in this area.

items.quote: So for the micro -irrigation business, o nce this plant is fully operational during this year, we are expecting that micro -irrigation business EBIT DA margin should improve by 1% to 1.5% only because of the contribution from this plant.
